The hotel dealt with this issue by calling the police and these "guests" were excorted out. Go NYPD! None of this was Yotels fault and they did an excellent job on remedying it. I would recommend this hotel. Room was a bit small bu comfy.

title: Nice Hotel, but ...
body:
First we got at the hotel to announce our arrival and store our luggage at 9h30 the morning. they we came back at 3h30 as requested by the hotel. They got an hard time to find our reservation.. then they said it's not ready. we waited 2h at the lobby. for an VIP room at 600$ night, this is unaceptable. 
VIP room with the hot tub are an rip-off, they are at the first level of the hotel (8 floor) the view is ok.. but you can get an way better view for half the price with the ordinary room. or paid an little bit more to get past the 13 floor.
breakfast a la carte is expensive and bad. really bad. 1 plate with 2 overcook eggs and 2 overcook sausage. really the dish look ridiculous. you need to paid extra to get fruit juice or potatoes.. come on.. potatoes! the dish is 9.95.. and you need to ask for the coffee, it's include but the waitress don't ask you if you want it. 
for the diner, the sushi was ok, steak ok, but the pork ramen DISCUSTING. no pork meat, only white fat cube.. and really ONLY the white fat.. we didn't touch it.. 
so at 600$ an night you can get it from other hotel, they will open you the doors and decoration will not be made of plastic.

title: Fun and super clean hotel
body: This is the first time I stayed at Yotel. I usually stay at 5 star hotels but this has been faraway the best hotel I stayed at. Super clean, fun decor, a fabulous outdoor eating space. The only comment I have is that the bed was rather hard. My bed at home is hard too, although not as hard as the hotel bed. The hotel staff did tell me that the beds will be replaced soon as they received more complaints about it. If you have kids, get the room with a loft bed suspended from the ceiling - super cool and no other hotel has this that I know of. Next time I am in NY I will stay at Yotel again.

title: Loved it !
body: We stayed in 4 hotels during our last holiday and this one was the best of all. Staff are very friendly and helpful, hotel is very clean. Rooms are small but there is everything you will need during your stay, you wont find the accessories you will find in other hotels like the mini bar, shower caps, cotton buds etc ..,. but many people don't use what the hotels provide anyway. There is a small area in every floor where you can use a fridge, have a coffee, tea or water which we found very comfortable, plus free WI-FI in every room and area of the hotel. I also liked the design of the hotel which is very modern and original. Location is excellent since its very close to times square but at the same time set in a quiet location. Will definately recommend!

title: Family Vacation
body: Overall great hotel, great service , rooms are clean , location is perfect. We were traveling with a two year old and he enjoyed his stay very much as well.

title: Very cool but not with kids
body:
I just came back from a 3 night stay at Yotel NYC. 
The hotel is very cool and adds up to the whole New York City experience. The pricing was also reasonable, considering it's a new hotel with a great location. However, I don't think it's a good place to go with kids:
1) Yotel is a party hub, hands down. Expect not only singles and couples but mostly a gay crowd. 
2) Most of the times there were several groups of guests smoking right in front of the hotel. This is the waiting area for cabs. Since I don't smoke, this was something that I didn't appreciate. I didn't like my toddler breathing that second-hand smoke either.
3) The space is small. Really small. Our lastest Disney cruise cabin was bigger than our cabin at the Yotel. The mattress was really hard and covered in plastic, which made it extremely warm at nights.
4) The restaurant is great. Most of our meals were there and we enjoyed every single one of them. However, no kids meals. The only thing kid-like they had were french fries...but they were so spicy my toddler couldn't eat them. 
So I'm sort of divided if it's my kind of hotel and if I would visit again...I loved the futuristic decor, the design, the technology that's present everywhere, the views from our room, the uber chic shower, the lavazza coffee machine on each floor...but would definitely prefer another ambiance, another kind of crowd...perhaps a more family-oriented one.

title: Great hotel!
body:
I really enjoyed staying at this hotel. The crew was very kind. Even when I had trouble with my cabin key, they were very helpful.
The hotel offers everything that we as a couple needed for our 1 week stay in NY. You get a small breakfast and there is a coffee & watermachine on every floor. There's a shower, a safe, free internet access... At night, I had a great time relaxing from all the NY noise (it's really quiet in the room)
At the last day we could store our luggage for free after we checked out. 
For those complaining about the small rooms. Please start reading the websites of the hotels that you want to book. This is clearly the concept of the hotel. What you see on the Yotel website is what you really get. Yotel offers different kinds of rooms, if this is what you need.
i'll definitely want to book this hotel again for my next trip to NY.

title: Fantastic Hotel!
body: I cannot say one bad word about Yotel, it was simply perfect in every way! I stayed here for two weeks with my boyfriend to celebrate my 30th birthday and experience my first ever visit to New York, I was not disappointed. The location is fantastic, so close to Times Square, Port Authority bus station and Subway all of which are walkable within 5-10 minutes. The hotel itself is a fab design, it is a very modern, arty and almost futuristic, The rooms are just great, fab big shower, great big window, extremely comfortable bed which moves! great HD Tv and the size of the rooms are great. The free coffee in the galley is delicious and they even have decaff! The muffins in the mornings are very tasty and sometimes you also get croissants and bagels. The Japanese restaurant - Dohyo, is well worth trying, the food is very tasty! The staff are all so friendly and helpful and the service was the best it couldve been. The terrace was lovely if you get the right weather its well worth sitting out there, it doesnt feel like you are in a busy city. The yobot that stores your luggage is well worth using if you have time to kill between check out and heading to the airport, its a great gadget, every hotel should have one! I cannot fault this hotel it is simply the best! oh also try the cocktails on the happy hour menu - very tasty! I had the holiday of a lifetime and couldnt have wished for a better place to stay.

title: Great hotel in a central location
body:
I stayed at the Yotel for 5 nights in March 2012
The location is great, a few blocks West of Times Square, and the area seemed pretty quiet the whole time i was there. Just a couple of minutes walk from the Bus Station, with a wide range of shops and diners locally
The hotel itself does have a young look and feel when you arrive. The electronic check in is easy and takes a couple of minutes.
I have stayed in New York a number of times before and found the room to be a good size in comparisson to some others. It was well furnished, clean and had everything i needed
I would have no problem staying here again on my next visit

title: A different kind of place
body: The Yotel is a different kind of place. Kind of a whole new concept in hotel design. Because it is so different, it is going to get a variety of reviews and some of the negative reviews will simply be a reaction to a new concept. My husband and I LOVED it. The rooms are small, but rooms in Manhattan are small. The difference here is an unbelievably efficient use of space which makes the limited space in the room very comfortable and functional. Decor is an awesome combination of simple, functional and contemporary. The place was spotlessly clean in every respect. The bathroom separated by a glass wall and a curtain apparrently bothers some people, but I thought it was very chic and attractive. TV with hookups for an MP3 player was awesome. Location is perfect, an easy walk to times square, located directly on a bus stop, and a short walk to a subway station. Close to coffee, restaurants, and even a grocery store across the street. Even if this place were not priced rediculously cheap, I would have loved it. The fact that the rates are incredibly reasonable for its location, probably makes it the best value in manhattan. I will be back here soon.

title: comfortable small room
body: A small room with one of the most comfortable beds I have slept in. Also able to use one of the computers next to the reception area free of charge, and able to keep up to date with the family. A quirky hotel with good staff.

title: Nice hipster spot
body: Like the concept - small clean rooms - imagine being inside an ipod (just bigger). Location is awesome. I will stay there again.

title: We loved Yotel!
body:
We stayed at Yotel for 5 nights in May and we loved the place! Check in was quick and easy, I emailed a few weeks before our stay to request a room on a higher floor and this was no problem at all, we were on floor 25. In my opinion the room didn't feel too small, especially as the bed could be put into a sofa position. After reading some other reviews we weren't sure if the bed would be very comfortable but it's absolutely fine! The only point I would note that has been mentioned in previous reviews is the slight lack of privacy in the shower/toilet area. It wasn't an issue for us but may be for some people. Our bed sheets and towels were changed everyday.
We didn't expect a breakfast but the free muffins and tea were great in the mornings and having the 'galley' on each floor was very handy for cold water and hot drinks.
We used the rooftop bar once and the atmosphere was great but the drinks were quite pricey compared to other places in the area. 
The staff were all very friendly and helpful. On our last day the staff stored our luggage for us (yobot didn't seem to be working) whilst we were out and about. The staff on the ground floor booked us a private car back to the airport. We were going to take a taxi but the private car company have a deal with the hotel and charge the same as a taxi ($90 fixed price). We booked the car for 4pm but ended up back at the hotel early so the staff went out and spoke to the drivers outside and arranged for us to leave the hotel earlier because we were ready to go. On our way into Manhattan we took the airport bus, it was really well priced but was a bit of a nightmare! It was so busy and the driver was getting really stressed out and arguing with passengers as he was trying to load everyone's luggage on the bus. It took well over an hour by the time the luggage was loaded on and the ticket woman had come round. The bus cost $16 one way and I normally would use a bus serivce rather than a taxi/pre-booked car as it's much cheaper but in this case it just wasn't worth the extra stress.
The only slight negative is that I wish the hotel was slightly closer to a subway stop and after a long day of sightseeing the walk from Times Square back to the hotel was a bit annoying. However, the positive points about Yotel far out weigh this. Highly recommend.

title: Different - but really good
body:
Bright and clean
Friendly and helpful staff
Innovative (Yobot, electric bed)
Good position, not far from Times Square and the subway
I'd stay there again

title: yo'll love it!!!
body: having had a LONG day travelling from london and having had to wait a life time for an newark airport bus we arrived at the yotel only to find that our reservation had been cancelled by expedia...but the yotel staff sorted this out in about 25 mins which was a major relief.the rooms were a decent size we had no problems with the size, the bed is controlled by a button that brings it down from a sofa to a bed, free tea/coffee and muffins at the end of each corridor and on the fourth floor. the stafff were always polite and helpful..location is about 10mins walk from time sq and port authority. im sure the prices will go through the roof in the coming years so check it out before they do!!!

title: Jimmy the receptionist =disgrace
body:
I stayed at the yotel over new years eve. Very funky and futuristic. Rooms are small, but that's normal for hotels around times square, if you want more room space book down town new York - that's what I will do next time. This was 2nd time staying near times square. If you want to relax after a long days shopping, then this hotel is probably to noisy for you. 2 reasons: 1. Friday, Saturday, Sunday the hotel turns into a night club where outsiders can come in and party. 2. You can hear people walking through corridors with luggage, bashing walls and doors etc... At 3,4,5,6am in the morning most nights. I noticed others opening their room doors and shouting to be quiet. The hotel has tried to squeeze as many rooms next to each other as possible I think, hence the walls are probably very thin...
 Lastly I was attacked by two people during an event in the hotel, my suit was ripped and I had a few cuts to my face. The two men who attacked me were drunk. I complained to reception and absolutely nothing happened. The head receptionist Jimmy Was dismissive and rude, I actually sensed the two attackers were his friends attending the party. I could go on about his rudeness and poor customer service skills a lot longer. I stayed at the Night hotel before - I would probably recommend this hotel over Yotel. If it wasn't for jimmy I would give this hotel a 3.5 to 4.

title: Yotel - Great Experience
body:
Just completed a 3 night stay at Yotel while on a business trip. Hotel is immaculate, I had room 1437 which is a corner upgrade cabin - could see the Hudson River from my room, and was treated to a viewing of the Parade of Ships for Fleet Week! Galley kitchen was next door - great water/ice machine, unlimited hot beverages any time you wanted, and soft drink vending machine that took credit cards.
Check-in was a breeze, with helpful staff guiding the process at the computer and I didn't even request it! 
Ordered takout from Doyho Restaurant - fast, good value for in-room food. You just order and pick it up from the bar on the 4th floor.
Only complaint - air conditioning is controlled by an in-room motion sensor, and one of the sensors in the room was not working, so while you were sleeping, the air conditioning would not come on. I had to get out of bed, stand in front of the door motion sensor and wave my hand to get the air conditioning to come on.
Other than that - thoroughly enjoyed my stay. CVS drug store and Food Emporium across the street. 2 blocks from Subway and Bus Terminal.
I will be back!

title: Delivers what it promises
body: Yes, the rooms might be a bit small - but so are most in NYC and you don't come to town to stay in the room. But it's all very modern, stylish and efficient for the price, and the staff are extremely friendly.

title: An amazing Hotel
body:
We passed a 6 days stay at yotel with friends, rooms are moderns and clean, well designed (It gaves me idea for my home.... ), staff is very carefully, the hotel is close of times square.
A very good experience. I recommend it to everybody.

title: Great Find
body: Before arriving we were slightly concerned about the size of the room - much is made of the compactness of the cabins and my husband is 6' 3" and we were travelling with a large suitcase as NYC was just our first stop. However, we need not have worried the design of the cabins is brilliant and we were very comfortable. The whole hotel was spotlessly clean and well designed. It was quirky and the majority of the customers were younger than us but we had a perfect stay. The galley on each floor meant we could have a hot drink when we wanted one and the complimentary breakfast was an unexpected saving. Our cabin was on a corner but we heard no noise from neighbours nor from people passing the door. Altogether perfect and a very good price for such a central location.

title: Trendy and good value for money
body: The rooms are spotless, iPad plug available. Room is small but everything is there. Roof top bar is excellent. Great valuel for money.

title: Yotel - more like Notel
body:
First of all, I didn't like the ongoing party atmosphere at all - it is all a gimmick, just like the free muffin and coffee you get each morning and it gets really busy around the lobby like a big happening going on.
The room was ok, didn't like the white decoration that looks a bit dirty, our sink wasn't clean and you could tell bleach would do the job but of course the "cabin crew"(= the cleaners in Yotel) won't clean it properly because they are an unusual team, the same gimmick here of let's try and look cool/funky with a bizarre way of cleaning.
The curtain in the room does not give you any privacy, especially when you have a shower and feel like everyone watch you from outside.
The galley on each floor which is a great idea - a kitchen that offers free Lavazza Coffee/tea and drinking water didn't function at all on our floor. I complained about it on our first night and no one cared as we had to use the floor above every time.
Location is not really as what it says "Times Square" but more of 10th Avenue. it takes about 10 mins to get to time square.
I know New York hotels are not cheap but I paid a lot of money for a 3 night stay in Yotel while my first night in New york was in Hotel Lola which was cheaper and much better - I guess I should have stayed there for the rest of my holiday.

title: A fabulous hotel with great holiday atmosphere.
body: My husband and I stayed at this hotel last weekend for four nights. Our room was extremely comfortable, clean and even though it was compact, the use of the space there is fantastic and makes the room feel larger than it is. The Terrace bar is fabulous and has a great party atmosphere at the weekends with locals using it also for birthday parties etc. The Hotel itself is really funky with automated check in which is quick and easy. The Galley on each floor is brilliant- we just used it for water at night but there is complimentary coffee and tea there also. Breakfast is lovely with a choice of complimentary coffee/muffins or you can have a full breakfast for $10.The location of the hotel is fantastic within five minute walk of Times Square. Great value for money. We most definitely will stay there again and highly recommend it to all of our friends.

title: Yotel experience
body: Friendly staff, spotless rooms, location is only 5 mins walk from Times Square or Hells Kitchen. Our 4 night break ticked all the boxes. Great funky tunes played in the elavators and a birds morning chorus greeted you for breakfast, really cool. Found that the terrace bar prices were a little heavy. Overall, a great hotel and recommended.

title: Brilliant Location, Great Hotel
body:
Great Hotel, in a Brilliant central Location. Stayed here for 5 nights. the room was small and there was only a thin curtain separating the sleeping area from the shower cubicle & toilet (which was right in front of the window!!). However it was plenty of room for the two of us, and it was comfortable and very clean. The complementary muffins were lovely for breakfast each morning, and the staff were all friendly and extremly helpful.
The location was about 5 minutes walk from Times Square and a 2 minute walk to the local Port authority bus terminal which makes it easy for day trips and airport runs.
The pubs and bars are plentiful in this area. there are some really nice lively places near the hotel if you want to enjoy a drink in the evening. Justin Timberlakes 'southern hospitality' restaurant is only about 2 blocks away and is definatly worth a visit if you are after some amazing soul food!
I would definatly stay here again and i would definatly recommend this place to anyone.

title: Great option for short NY stays
body: Great funky hotel. Small rooms, but everything you need. Great bar and shared space.

title: 10 out of 10!!!
body:
As we walked into Yotel we knew this was no ordinary hotel.This was our first time in New York so we had spent a good period of time choosing a place to stay,thank God we found this gem.
There were 4 in our party (two couples) and we had been looking forward to the seeing the hotel for real as we were very impressed with the website.
The check in was quick and smooth,there was staff all buzzing round ready to help but we chose to use the computer and within 3 minutes we were on our way to our rooms.
Once in the room we were blown away by how modern, clean and well thought out they were -they were just like the pictures on the website! We knew the size of the room before we got there but were shocked at how well the space was used.
The bed was really comfy and will retract when you are walking around and getting ready which was cool, large tv on the wall with an ipod dock, enough draws and space for clothes and bags etc...the shower was great, there's even an ironing board with iron in the room. 
The rooms have to be seen to be believed. 
Out of your room is just as comfortable, every floor has a coffee station which is a brilliant idea -just go to the room and make your coffee or tea and while you wait have a chat to other guests. The bar, dining and general chillout area of the hotel are just like the website shows; clean, modern, well staffed and a real cosmopolitan feel to them. At breakfast there is free coffee and muffins which everybody took advantage of - great place to sit and plan your day!
We found ourselves being drawn back to hotel every day at 5 oclock from where ever we were in New York...the reason? Happy hour! Amazing value for money on food and drinks, in fact the food was some of the best we had in the city. 
Another great plus point is the location, a 10 minute walk from Times Square! I cannot recommend this hotel enough and have done even to people who arent even going to New York! 
Thanks to everyone at the hotel, from the managers to the cabin crew to the bar staff and cooks, and the glass collectors, you gave us the best time ever and we will be back to New York very soon,where will we stay? Yotel of course, where else!!!

title: great find
body:
We stayed for 7 nights at yotel for our honeymoon in new york. 
It is certainly very different form any hotel you've stayed in before!
We arrived at Yotel at about 10pm flying from the UK and it was abit confusing and alot to take in to have a 9 hour flight and then walk into someones graduation party and 'nightclub' but it was Saturday night and once we got upto our room (on the 27th floor) you wouldn't even know all the madness going on on the 4th floor. We never heard anything through the walls (apart from someones kid screaming one morning outside our door but it happens) 
The rooms and hotel in general was always clean and spotless and a lovely cool temperature in the room at all times. we had a fantastic view from our window aswell.
Not a downside, but something i wasn't expecting, was the lack of privacy in the bathroom area of the room. Not brilliant for newly weds when we have to ask each other 'to get a cup of coffee' while you go to the bathroom but im sure it doesnt both other people! 
The take out that we had from the dohyo restaurant was lovely aswell. 
'Breakfast' could be elaborated on a little more perhaps, but i guess the cost of breakfast is put into other areas of the hotel which i fully appreciate.
A great hotel, and relatively close to times square and where we wanted to go.
thanks Yotel!

title: YES to Yotel!
body: I saw this hotel on hotels.com when looking for a reasonably priced place but opted for another hotel which was less. The other hotel was a nightmare. While having the room cleaned, I walked around and came across Yotel on 10th Ave., which I recognized from my search, went in to ask for directions to the entrance to the High Line Park, and was so struck by the feel of the place, I asked what the price for a room was, were there any available and could I see a room. I was assisted in a matter of minutes. The staff is friendly, helpful, clearly happy to be there, and the hotel is very well maintained and clean. I too was concerned about the size of the rooms, but for my purposes, it was perfect. They have done a great job of utilizing every square inch of space. I would recommend this to anyone! Thank you, Yotel, for a great stay!

title: We will Never stay anywhere else when in NY!
body:
We were looking for a reasonably priced hotel in Manhattan. Yotel was not only very reasonable, but also in a fantastic location. It is within walking distance to Time Square, Restaurant Row, Broadway, Grey Line Bus Tours, the Intrepid and the Port Authority. It's also just a really cool place to stay. You have to go to their website to see what I mean.
We have to give them praise for their customer service! From the moment we pulled up to the door until the time we left, we received some of the best customer service we have ever experienced! (Even compared to some very expensive luxury hotels we had previously stayed at.) When we pulled up to Yotel, the doormen were there waiting with umbrellas, our car doors were opened, we were assisted out of the van and my mother was assisted into her wheelchair. Our bags were taken in before I even knew it. I literally stood there for a second waiting to get my bags when one of the doormen said, “We’ve already taken them inside.” 
Upon arrival, I was extremely upset with our transportation service from the airport, Go Airlink NYC. (However, that is another review I highly encourage you to read before booking with them.) Josef, who was escorting us into Yotel, saw how upset I was and without hesitation told me not to worry about a thing. As soon as he got us checked in and settled, he could arrange for another transportation service to take us back to the airport when we needed it. Immediately, Josef made me feel welcomed, reassured, and relaxed (not an easy thing to do). Kudos to you Josef!!! 
From that moment on, we never had to open a door, push the elevator button or hail a cab ourselves. We were very impressed with how the staff treated us. They anticipated our every need, made eye contact and most importantly they never seemed to be distracted with other things when interacting with us. It was obvious WE were their priority, no matter what. And throughout our stay, Josef was not only exceptional with customer service, but we found him to be invaluable with information and recommendations!
There are a few things you need to know about Yotel before you go that were not really explained to us. First, the cabin windows look to be, but are NOT, one way glass. So if you stand in front of them naked, everyone on the street WILL see you. Second, the air conditioner in your cabin is set on a motion sensor, so when you leave your room it shuts off and the temp rises to 75 degrees. When you return to your room it will be warm, but the sensors will kick in again and it only takes about 20 min. to cool back down. Third, the concierge, by Mission Control on the 4th floor, is a separate service contracted out by Yotel. Don’t mistake their subpar service for Yotel’s. Yotel would be better off using their own staff as the concierge service since we seemed to get better info and recommendations from them. The concierge’s transportation service is Go Airlink NYC b/c they have a contract with them. Yotel’s transportation service is Damus Limo Service (dial 711 from you cabin). The drivers are extremely professional and service oriented, the cars are truly luxury vehicles and they have the best rates in town to boot!!!! 
We will definitely stay at Yotel on our next trip to NY and will look for one when traveling elsewhere! Job well done Jeffrey Mills, G.M.!

title: Great Stay!!!
body: Me and my girlfriend had gone to a Rangers game on may 25th i believe and we spent one night here at Yotel. We loved it! The view from our room was amazing since we were on the 14th floor. The room was fairly small but very cozy. The whole hotel has a very futuristic/Japanese appeal to it. The place is very interesting and very different from any other hotel we have ever been to, it was great! The restaurant and bar was very nice, there is also a deck outside where you can hang with people and have drinks. The only thing i didn't like about the room was that there was no refrigerator in the room!! For me this would be a problem if i was staying multiple nights because i would go to the 24hr CVS across the street and bring back sodas/juices/snacks and would like a fridge to keep them in!

title: Something new for a change
body:
This is a new hotel in NY and for the most part, they are off to a great start. The staff was extremely professional and easy to deal with. The music is fun and diverse (they should sell compilations of their music as i think it would be of interest to the people that specifically like Yotel). The hotel is in midtown Manhattan making it easy to get a cab and get right into the action. The subway is just two city block away and is very convenient to take to JFK. 
Just a few things to point out. If you are sensitive to noise you may find it a little difficult to fall asleep. The surfaces or the doors and cabinets are hard and are easy to accidentally slam and can be heard through the room walls. This is an easy fix that would further enhance the already enjoyable stay we had. For those of you that stay on the 8th floor note that the corner cabin right above the patio can get a little noisy however it usually closes by 11pm and is nice and quiet shortly there after. I will point out that you can hear the patin door slam from room 817 and it rattles the windows in the cabin. Once again this is an easy fix that would greatly enhance the overall experience. When taking a shower it is rather easy to get water outside of the shower are and that water will not drain and will have to be moped up or left for the cleaning crew. This may be a little harder to fix as they would have to redo the bathrooms. I ended up putting an extra towel on the floor while I showered and that solved the problem.
Conclusion. This was the first time we have ever stayed at a Yotel location and overall we really enjoyed it. I hope they ill address some of these nominal issues but would still recommend the hotel as is. I think if you have never been, Yotel is a new and fun place that will leave an overall positive stamp in the back of your mind.

title: Funky and top qualility hotel at a reasonable price nearTime Square
body:
Yotel was a great surprise. Normally hotels do look better on the internet, but Yotel was an exception!
The entire concept is very innovative - delivering a great prodcut, keeping it simple and at a great value for money!
The location is also great - 5min walking distance to the nearest subway station and 10min distance to Time Square. Besides there are tones of great restaurantes at 46th ST between 9th and 7th avenue.

title: Yotel, NYC May 18, 2012
body: This hotel is not very well run. The room was not cleaned, junk on the floor, no bath mat on the floor, and they left dirty towels in the room for us to use again. I would never stay here again.

title: Shockingly fabulous!
body:
I don't normally bother to do this but I was so happy with my stay at the Yotel that I felt compelled to put on a review so that other's could experience the fab'ness of the Yotel! Hi-tech, funky and luxurious was my experience. Had a truly amazing view of the new york skyline with a whole wall in our room which was completely glass. What a view in the middle of the night with all the lights!!! The lobby staff were fab, nothing was too much trouble. The room was great, clean, modern and functional, with an electronic bed which reclined to a sofa! Free muffins and coffee for breakfast a bonus, taken on the terrace overlooking the city! I have a few minor comments, but these totally do not detract from the wonderfulness of this hotel and I would, without hestitation, stay there again! 
1. Didn't appear to be a subway very close by, although I could have missed it!
2. I was travelling as a lone adult with a child, but we were put in a queen bed, my child is 9, so it didn't really matter, but may be worth asking for the rooms with a separate child bunk if you're child is any older.
3. The hotel weren't able to phone and order the Shuttle Bus for the airport without adding a hefty surcharge, they were very apologetic, however you can phone them free from your room phone before you check out.
Brilliant place. highly recommended and i've been 5 time and always stayed in different hotels but would stay here for a repeat visit!

title: Very good location but not so comfortable
body:
The hotel is very "modern" in terms of decoration. There is also a night club on 4th floor very much know to NewYorkers. The rooms are very small, but let's say ergonomics. The still remain too small. The free breakfust provided to everybody is nothing special. Just coffee and muffins but in every level there is a room where you can make tea, hot chocolate, different kinds of coffee etc. 
Our bigest probleme, as we staid for a week was the toilet which was inside the room, separated by a glass. No door, just a curtain that you could pool, but every smell and every single sound was like it was next to the bed. Auful! Very very modern ok, but not practical at all. However I understood why the did it. It was because the toilet is right next to the window that sees to the street, so yes, you can pie and se people walking in the city the same time (I think they can't see you thank God) and so if there was a separative wall, then the room wouldn't have a window. 
Anyway, the location was really good. You can walk to times square in 10 minutes and go to the metro station in 5 minutes. It's near broadway and very very convenient for vacation. 
I would just probably look for a room with a normal toilet!

title: Yotel NYC is fantastic
body: We spent three nights a Yotel. The location is great. The hotel amenities are just right. It was very clean. The staff is wonderful and fun. And the terrace and restaurant area allowed us to socialize with friends without having to leave the property. Can't wait to return to Yotel.

title: can not get much better!
body: Me and my wife stayed here for 5 nights, rooms are excellent location is excellent staff are excellent. You will not find a better hotel in New York for this price.

title: The perfect hotel
body:
The perfect hotel for a trip to New York: great location, great atmosphere, friendly helpful staff, modern well equipped rooms and a 24 hour CVS opposite.
I was surprised how much I enjoyed staying here. Yeah the rooms are 'compact' but that's what you expect - it was more about the extras that you get and how good a night sleep you have. And Yotel NYC delivered on both.
Only things to watch for are the fiddly air conditioning controls - our room was either too warm or freezing cold. And if travelling with friends beware that the bathroom has no door - just a curtain - so it may not be as private as you'd like!

title: Nice modern hotel with many amenities
body:
This is a refreshing new hotel from a Japanese firm. The decor is modern, the check-in kiosks are cool, and the cost is reasonable.
The rooms are small and cabin-like but very well laid out. The bed had a futon mattress that at first seemed thin, but it wasn't uncomfortable at all.
The hotel is non-smoking, but the hallway to our room had strong cigarette smoke smell upon departure. That was the only minor issue.

title: Superb hotel and service
body:
I booked here for 7 days in January because of good reviews and it was extremely well priced in a myriad of expensive hotels in NYC. I was not disappointed. 
The rooms are great with a new modern design and aesthetic. It was big enough for me and my girlfriend, although it can seem a bit cramped when your bags are on the floor as there's minimal storage space. The retractable bed seemed gimmicky but really did help create room once you were done actually sleeping in the bed. There is a nice bathroom but be warned is quite intimate for anyone other than a couple as it's just another part of the same room. 
There is free tea, coffee, water, fridge on each floor which was a nice touch and the staff were extremely helpful. It's nice to be able to print off a ticket at reception and not be charged for it!
The restaurant is nice and breakfast provided is muffins and hot drinks. Whilst appreciated, someone not used to so much sugar in the morning will probably be better going out for breakfast. 
To top it off the location was excellent, just a short walk from Broadway and Times square. 
I would definitely recommend!

title: A good and efficient hotel with nice location
body:
The Yotel is mostly about good basic facilities at an central location in Manhattan. Service is very 21st century (automated check in, Ipod connections, Free Wifi, Free use of desktops, "galley" with free coffee and water). They also have a great terrace for drinks. Staff is friendly and helpfull. Rooms are clean and reasonable size fo NYC (where all rooms are small).
Would definitely recommend!

title: This is a really hard one to review because it appeals more to some than others
body:
Have stayed in hotels all over the world. This is about my 10th time in New York. Staying at the Yotel.
What's Good
1. It is funky, modern, loud music, purple lights, lots of young people, alive
2. The room feels like you are stepping into an ipod with lots of white and plastic.
3. Clean
4. Free contintenal breakfast
5. Nice 10 min walk to Times Square
6. Staff have all been friendly
7. Great outdoor bar
8. Good value
What's not
1. The room is very small. It feels like you're in first class on a plane rather than a hotel
2. The bed has to be electronically folded down so that it can fit in the room to sleep on.
3. The bathroom is tiny with no real privacy from the room. It is more of a pod than a separate room
4. The shower pressure is very poor
5. I was woken many times by people walking in the hall and talking. The door is paper thin
6. No room service, no gym, no real on site facilities.
The Bottom Line
If you are young, on a budget, like to party, and dont care about space, this is a great hotel for you.
If like me you are older, can afford to pay more, and would be happy to do so for a bigger, quieter room then stay elsewhere.
I might stay here again but I probably won't.

title: Great experience!
body:
We were a little concerned about this hotel, as the price to stay was reasonable and in a great area. However, the hotel was beautiful, the staff were helpful, and the look was so modern. Loved the ambiance. The rooms were small (as you'll find in most NYC hotels) but awesome! It was just blocks from Times Square and the Subway station. Being in Hell's Kitchen, there were many different and affordable restaurants to chose from and was a nice change from the tourist chain restaurants in Times Square. Free wifi and a nice computer station was a plus. We were able to print our boarding passes at the hotel, free of charge. The concierge helped us to pick a harbor tour, which was also a few blocks away. Free muffins and tea/coffee was so nice in the morning. We didn't bother eating breakfast anywhere else, since they filled us up on the patio - a lovely setting to start and plan the day's adventures.
It should be noted that there isn't much blocking the sound from the washroom (in the hotel room), as the walls are glass and do not reach the ceiling. 
Our only complaint was the bartending staff on the roof-top patio. Many of the staff were not pleasant and didn't seem to enjoy working there. However, not a huge deal since we didn't stay at the hotel long in the evenings and there were so many other bars in the area.
We would definitely stay at the Yotel again,on our next NYC trip!

title: Love the Yotel!
body:
Just back home in Ireland from a trip to Boston and New York and we loved the yotel in new york.We had booked a bigger room,it was a corner queen cabin with an excellent room and was well worth the extra money.Me and my boyfriend loved everything about Yotel and my mam and dad were on holidays with us too and they really liked it too.They also had a corner queen cabin.The only complaint they had was that their wet room shower leaked a bit and the water came out across the bathroom floor!! 
The terrace bar is stunning with great views,staff are so helpful and it has an ideal location with only a few minutes walk to times square and also has plenty of bars and restaurants directly across the road.Lovely area,lovely hotel,we really enjoyed our stay at Yotel!

title: Good hotel as long as you go in knowing what to expect
body: We had a very good experience at this hotel but it might not be for everyone. Location - fantastic, within a short walk to Times Square and the subway. Price - fantastic. Room - on the small side, but then again, if you're in NYC, how much time are you spending in your room? Other than size, the only complaints about the room were (a) the bed isn't too comfortable, and (b) the bathroom is divided by a curtain and rolling glass door. Meaning you have to turn on the TV whenever you, ahem, do your business (assuming someone else is in the room with you). The concierge was helpful. There's a rooftop bar on the 4th floor that was pretty cool. Would definitely consider going there again.

title: Yo-tastic
body:
Really enjoyed our stay at Yotel, but can echo what others have said - it may not be to everyone's taste. We really liked the fact that the place was really friendly but also allowed you to be anonymous. In an expensive city the price and the free breakfasts were a real bonus. 
Liked the fact that there was a kitchen with a fridge available - keeps the mess out of your room - some may find it inconvenient having to go down the corridor for a drink. The rooms have everything you need - granted they're 'bijou' but what do you intend using them for? If you need space - go hang out on 4. We only ever came back when we were ready to collapse in a heap. The only issue for the shy might be the bathroom/toilet area which is screened by a flimsy curtain - with my partner so not an issue.
It's well placed - The M10 bus will take you uptown and the 42 will take you cross town -bus stops right outside the hotel. Port authority - 5 minute walk links you to the subway. Get a 7 day $29 unlimited metro card and make the most of the city.
The facilities on 4 are good - free breakfast, good food, free use of computers, bars, gym, outside deck, dj's at night, space to watch the world go by - all very relaxed and whilst it might seem 'too young' for some, all sorts of people stay and all are welcome. The music in the lifts might seem a little loud but it doesn't follow you to the rooms. Some people mentioned loud corridors - you can have that in any hotel - didn't notice myself, but then I use earplugs at night!
Room and hotel was clean. We were slobbing out one late afternoon in our room before heading out into the heat again so the cleaner couldn't get in to the room. Had a phone message on our return to apologise . Nice level of service and attentiveness that you don't always get - staff always saying hello, holding elevator doors, asking how your vacation was going etc.
Would recommend this hotel and would happily return

title: One word...awesome
body:
This was a trip that we took last week to celebrate my boyfriend's birthday. From check-in to check out...the experience was seamless. You use a kiosk to complete check in/out. Once we got to our room it was clean and had a wonderful view of the Empire State building and the Freedom Towers in the far distance. The hotel is just two blocks away from Times Square...we never used a taxi to get anywhere except the airport. The neighborhood is lively and fun at night. The staff was friendly and very helpful. If you have a late flight and want to explore town after checking out...you MUST use the Yobot. It's free and it will hold your luggage while you are out on the town. 
Overall, this was a great experience. Warning, the rooms are not that big and the beds are a little hard, but they are modern and very clean.

title: Great stay for young couples
body:
We arrived this past weekend Saturday June 2. We had a room on the 9th floor over looking the suites below. You enter the hotel through the downstairs garage elevator. It costs $39 for 24hrs parking. You can access the garage from the right side of the hotel. We arrived in the main lobby which is called Mission Control. We checked in using the kiosk but there is staff to help if you are not comfortable using the kiosk. We took the elevator to the 4th floor and then from there you have to take another set of elevators to the rooms. The 4th floor is where the lounge/club, outside terrace bar and restaurant is located. There was a lot of young adults at the hotel which was good, I didn't feel like we were in a stuffy old hotel. The regular rooms are small but if you do not plan to spend all day in your hotel room it is perfect. Not everyone is crazy having the bed right next to the bathroom but it was okay. The bed was good for my back since I like firm beds. The bed reclines which was pretty cool. I like how I could watch tv while I am taking a shower. You can literally see someone taking a shower since the shower and toilet are behind glass doors. You can also see outside the window at the suites below so you can see people in the whirlpools below...kind of funny. You can crack the bottom window in the bathroom that was cool. There was a galley on each floor that you can get water, coffee, tea etc. 
I suggest they change the floors in the bathroom. The floor is all messed up and scratched up, it looks bad.
We really enjoyed our stay and will come back because it was a nice hotel and a great price.

title: New design hotel & good located
body: We had a really good stay in this hotel. Design, clean, good located (just a few minutes from Time Square) including a small but enjoyable breakfast (as most of the hotels in NYC don't include the breakfast), coffee + muffin. The rooms are a little bit small but its ok as you are not spending your time in the room, and you have to consider that the rooms in New York are quite small. The only negative point is that the bathroom in the room is only divided by a curtain but its ok if you turn TV on! I will definitely go back for my next trip in New York.

title: Awesome, fantastic modern hotel!!!
body: The highly efficient executive assistant, Colleen Fink, friendly Yesenia at mission control and JJ and Elvis are staff members I have to mention for their outstanding service. All the staff is so friendly and helpful. Yotel is a wonderful, modern, futurestic, clean hotel with an excellent location and great value for money. 24h CVS across the road, two blocks to port authority metro, 3 blocks to Times Square, walking distance to great restaurants in Hells Kitchen. Free coffee and muffins every morning and galley with coffee machine on every floor. Stayed for 6 nights and couldn't be happier with the Yotel, it was awesome stay!!!!!

title: Excellent hotel!
body: Very competent and friendly staff, Simone at mission control deserves special mentioning. Great location, very modern and clean. Free wifi and breakfast. Will definitely stay here again. Thanks!

title: Great hotel
body:
I was a bit concerned that reviews indicated that this hotel was for younger people, I disagree as if you like a clean, modern, bright hotel that provides a good service including complimentary breakfasts, galleys on each floor with great free coffee and tea, excellent luggage storage, lovely terrace bar, free use of computers and printers, helpful advice on restaurants, bars and attractions then this hotel is suitable for any age.
We chose the Yotel for the position in Midtown and proximity to subway and buses. My only complaints were the rooms are a bit small and you have little privacy in the bathroom also the air con is a bit hit and miss but this no way spoiled the experience.
Close to some great restaurants on 9th Avenue, lovely receptionist recommended a good Japanese bar on (I think) 46th Street where we had great cocktails that were half price as it was a Monday! For breakfast I recommend the Market Diner on 11th.

title: DOORS DO NOT AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE/LOCK
body:
First of all i'll start with the good:
The hotel is really cool, i like the "airplane cabin" idea. Something really different, and also the check in is really different and cool.. Concierge staff were great, made really good first impressions.
The idea of everything being on the 4th floor and being the centre of the business was cool, had Mac's there to use free of charge and a restaurant and bar and many other things
Awesome location, i walked to and from the hotel at all hours of the night and always felt safe
Bad:
The doors do not always lock/close completely if you let them just close.. you have to manually push the door completely shut.. I'm not used to this, especially with hotels and became a problem when i was in a rush and i'd run back to the room to check if the door was closed (sometimes it wasnt)
The first night i didnt realise the door wasn't completely shutting... i woke up in the middle of the night to hear someone walking through my room. i was laying on my stomach and froze straight away and a couple of seconds later i felt them lay ontop of me and then pull the blanket down over my head and then all of a sudden the pressure ontop of me was gone (possibly realised i was a male and left) 
I told the "mission control" staff 3 times to get the door checked out, i didnt tell them of the incident because it was inappropriate to bring up infront of other guests and i was kind of embarassed.. the door wasnt sorted
on the last day of my stay i brought it up and told them the incident and it sounded like she was genuinely concerned and apologised etc.. maybe the problem would be looked at?
i got an email asking for a feedback survey.. wrote everything there and a manager responded asking more questions and said the engineering dept said nothing was wrong with the door... despite me having to manually push the door shut 80% of the time...
Got a response back saying the doors do not completely shut and are required to be manually shut because if they shut and locked on their own it would cause a noise disturbance to other guests...
Of course after the first incident i was locking the door and putting the latch over it and putting my bag up against the door...
I suppose maybe they will change the doors when somebody has their belongings stolen or gets raped next time....

title: Good hotel and location
body: I stayed at the Yotel New York for a one week holiday in late May, and I found the hotel to be very good. The room was small but very well planned, wth a comfortable bed/sofa. Subway stations are only a few minutes walk, at Port Authority Bus Terminal and Times Square 42ns Street.

title: Great hotel
body: We are French, and very satisfied by the yotel : it's a bright hotel which provides good services, original room, good breakfast with various muffins, a lovely terrace, and crew members very competent and very nice. It's near Times Square. I recommend this hotel for a couple.

title: A Fun and Cool Hotel
body: This hotel was really fun-it's concept is cool and they had an amazing use of space in the cabins as the rooms are called. The hotel had really nice views and close to all attractions and even parking (1 block away)--we paid $42 overnight. The staff are fabulous--helpful and attentive, nice bar on the 4th floor and beautiful on a summer night--unique experience, nice for an overnight--good deal $214 on hotels.com. They offered complimentary breakfast with coffee and great muffins. We had the breakfast special (toast 2 eggs comes with your choice of bacon or sausage for $10). Also with free WIFI. I would stay here again but it doesn't seem like a place where you can get a good night's sleep. We got in a 2AM and someone came in at 3:30AM talking in the hallway like she was the only one in the world, doors slamming and you can hear the shower next door. If you're okay with that then this hotel fits the bill--it has everything and it's nice and clean. This is a hotel to keep on the list for short stays in NY--really a great hotel especially if sleep is not what you're going to NY for. I can't say I would never go back--I really liked it minus my lack of sleep!

title: Simply the best Hotel experience ever
body:
We booked Yotel through Amtrak and were very skeptical about it, especially since we were travelling to NYC with our 16-month old. But this turned out to be the best experience we ever had at any Hotel...anywhere in the World (and we do travel a lot).
We arrived at 8:30am in the morning, it was bit rainy. So we thought we will leave our bags at Hotel. To our surprise the room was ready and we could check in at 8:30am in NYC! Also they dont have a lobby, so no annoying wait times, you just check in thru a kiosk and get your room key. They dont keep your card on file, so you know exactly what you pay for. No useless crap like Pay-per-view, etc.
The room was but thats a given in NYC for any Hotel. But the design was just perfect. It had exactly what u need where u need. In fact my wife and I were discussing stealing some of their ideas for our home! best part was they had a full window which remained closed...and our baby would love to sit and watch the city.
Each floor has a pantry that has a microwave, common refrigerator (blessings for travelling with baby) and FREE coffee, hot chocolate and water. Now this is no crappy US-style coffee. They have a cappuccino maker that actually made coffee that was better than Starbucks'...seriously, I know my coffee! And yes, we are mostly going to buy that model coffee maker too.
Just 3 blocks from Times Square so we could do multiple trips back and forth. And on 4th floor they have a big party area where our toddler loved to run around.
We were absolutely satisfied with our stay. All Hotels should be like this. Yotel, you got it right. Next time we are travelling I will first check if they city has a Yotel!

title: Affordable, clean, modern hotel in a great location!
body:
When I looked for a hotel in New York, I wanted a hotel in Manhattan, in a good location. I also wanted the hotel to be clean and modern. Yotel was the perfect match!
Ok the room are a bit small (they call them cabin) but they are very well designed so you don't feel like it is too small. And when you are in New York for a long weekend, you want to spend as much time as possible visiting the city! The bed can also be moved electronically during the day to give you more space to walk around the room. They are also quite a lot of storage.
The bathroom is not separated by a wall or a door but by a light curtain. You can't see through the curtain though. It was fine for us as we are husband and wife. It might be more complicated if you are travelling with friends. 
The location is great, only 10 min from Times Square, 5 min from the Pier where you can get the boats for the Hudson cruises/boat trips. It is close to everything but not noisy! 
Complimentary breakfast is tea/coffee and muffins. There are 3 or 4 kind of muffins and they are really tasty. You can have your breakfast on the terrace of the hotel with a nice view. 
If you want a more consistent breakfast, you can pay $9 per person.
The hotel also have facilities for lunch and dinner. We tried the dinner the first night we arrived as we were tired and did not want to leave the hotel. It was a huge disappointment. The food was below average and the service so poor. The value of money is very low. We should have gone somewhere else. 
It was our only bad experience and the staff in general was really helpful and efficient. One person behaviour did not change our view of the hotel in general.
If we have the chance to visit New York again, we will strongly consider Yotel again, but just to sleep! ;-)

title: We loved this hotel--great location--wonderful staff.
body: An old friend and I met in NYC for a weekend and we stayed at the Yotel--Since I knew the rooms were on the smallish side--and I prefer some space when I travel, I booked two rooms. Every nook and cranny in the room was designed to function. The bed was awesome. I loved being able to lower and raise the head of the bed. Only noise was from some guests in the hallway on way to their rooms late at night. We were among the few guests that spoke "American" English. A very international hotel. We were also among the oldest guests. The staff on the ground floor was upbeat and extremely helpful. Outside terrace on 4th floor was very nice for a late night cocktail. Would definitely return.

title: DEFINATELY A MUST STAY HOTEL(YOTEL)
body: Stayed in the great hotel 4 adults in the double bunk room....plenty of room for everyone you are only there to sleep....I cant wait to go back to NYC this will be my first place to stay...it is a spaceship in the middle of NYC..place is clean..great staff..and location location location is it 2 blocks from times square. I parked at the parking garage under the hotel 39 day (24 hour) took the elevator up and we were at mission control ...CHECK THIS PLACE OUT YOU WILL LOVE IT

title: Great first stay at Yotel
body:
Stayed at Yotel for 3 nights in June 2012. What we liked:
- the comfortable bed - it's like a futon, very firm, you don't notice when/if the other person moves - and there were 4 good quality pillows - had great sleeps - nice that the bed folds up to provide additional space in the small cabin
- big flat screen TV built into the wall with all kinds of storage, shelving, cup holders, etc. around it
- lots of mirrors and lights
- plentiful electrical outlets
- alarm clock built into the wall beside the bed - at the desk
- a handy tray provided for carrying coffee, muffins, water etc. from the galley or 4th floor to your room
- bathroom - lots of shelves, towel bars, storage areas, lighted mirror, organic body wash/shampoo provided, nice 'rain' style shower
- floor to ceiling window in bathroom and window can be opened
- free wifi
- electronic safe (located in the bathroom)
- fast elevators
- everything very clean (small exception - people mess up the galley with coffee spills etc. and don't clean up after themselves!)
- helpful, friendly staff - helped with luggage storage, obtaining taxi to airport
- good location - easy walk to Times Square, subway stations, but far enough away to be quieter at night
- view of the river from 20th floor was nice
We will definitely stay here again!

title: Fun atmosphere,great value
body:
The yotel is true to it's concept - easy access,crisp functional design, social atmosphere - what you need for a comfortable nest in the city for those not planning to spend too much time in their rooms. I've stayed a couple of times now for business. For one person, the small room offers what I need- comfortable bed, free wifi, sunny crisp room and complimentary coffee. Staff is super friendly and the indoor/outdoor bar is great. Restaurant food is quite good but there is no room service. Coffee and muffins offered free in the morning but full breakfast is available 
Crowd is very international and mostly younger making the lobby and bar very lively 
Hotel is close to lots of great restaurants and bars and easy train or cab to wherever else you want to go 
Lots of places to access wifi and work in the lobby! 
One downside- for just me the small room is perfect. I wouldnt choose the hotel to stay as a couple. Way too small and utilitarian. But if you're on a budget and don't plan on staying too much in the room it's clean,comfortable and great value

title: YOTEL- Highly recommended
body:
Location: great! very easy access to public transport and a short walk (less than 10 min) toTimes square.
The hotel itself has a very funky, vibrant and modern design. Every week-end there is some live djs and lots of very nice people.Rooms are very compact but average size for a city hotel
However, I must admit that during the happy hour in the bar, cocktail were very very poor, honestly the only thing that disappointed us.
Great for friends, couple but I would not recommended for families , especially those with small children. 
The earlier you book , the better price you get.Try those comparison sites, like trivago, for the best price ever.

title: Great Hotel, wish we could have spent more time in our room
body: We have just returned from a 4 night stay at the Yotel. We did not want to come home. Friendly staff, great to have complimentary coffee and muffins at breakfast time. Great location and view. Loved the outdoor terrace. We had an evening flight so we were able to leave our luggage at the hotel for no charge during the day. Cannot think of anything negative to say.

title: Clean, modern, hip and fun!
body: My family loved YOTEL in NYC! We stayed one night on a Saturday night. It was just a block away from one of our off-broadway shows and just two (long) blocks from Times Square. 9th and 10th Ave in the 40s and 50s have a great and seamingly endless choice of restaurants. Our reservation was ready at noon. The entire hotel has the look and feel of staying in an "I-pod". The room was small, but it was immaculate and made exceptionally good use of the space (think a WELL designed cruise ship cabin). Three of us fit nicely in the space provide. The room had an number of excellent features, including spot light reading lights, electric blinds, an ipod dock, flat screen TV, safe, and hair dryer. There is a galley on each floor, which has a communal fridge, beverage vending, free coffee and cocoa, and a purified water/ice machine. Our room was adjacent to the galley and I was concerned about the potential for noise. Although we heard people entering and leaving the room, it never disturbed us. In the morning, there were free muffin and coffee in the 4th floor lobby. We checked our bags with Yobot (see their website for an explanation!) and returned at 7pm to retrieve. For NYC, this hotel was a great value and a lot of fun. Great job YOTEL!

title: Overpriced, but interesting
body: I stayed at Yotel NY for 3 nights in June 2012. Above all else, the hotel certainly is interesting. It's design and operation is very unique, from the lack of receptionists (you check in and out yourself using computer kiosks) to the odd purple lighting found throughout the entire hotel. From a comfort standpoint, the bed was quite hard, and the placement of the central A/C vent was positioned such that it blew directly onto my face when sleeping. Both of those were negatives in my opinion. Also, the room rates are pretty out of control at this place, considering how far west the hotel is (it's a good 10 minute walk to the nearest subway stop). I would not stay here again unless the rate was a fantastic deal and there were no other more convenient options.

title: A Superb Experience...
body:
I stayed at Yotel for four nights with my girlfriend in June 2012. My experience echoes the sentiments of many that have stayed before me. The cabins are of a perfectly adequate size for a couple wanting to explore and experience NYC! 
There is ample storage for two, a very comfortable sleeping arrangement with a futon type bed, excellent bathroom facilities, free WIFI (handy for planning trips and booking tickets on your tablet/laptop) and free coffee/water. The coffee and muffins that are provided every morning are perfect to see you through to lunch and a surprising variety of these are offered. For those wanting to sleep in - the black out blinds offer you the opportunity to do so. 
The staff are superb and surpassed our expectations with every question we asked them. The robotic storage of suitcases is also very helpful for those with later flights that do not want to carry their cases up the empire state building!
Location is perfect - we did all of the tourist hot spots (including the obligatory shopping), all of which were accessible from Yotel either by foot or the local subway. It's also very close to the bus terminal which is handy for the airport transfers. 
There is quite a young and vibrant feel to the hotel which is something to consider if you're travelling with children or you're of a slightly older age. Having said this - no noise can be heard from the rooms at all!
I cannot really fault this experience!

title: Modern, fabulous hotel!
body: Simone at mission control is so friendly, helpful and efficient, thank you for all your help! This is a modern, clean, completely different hotel with an excellent location, 2 blocks from Times Square, across the road from Hell's Kitchen, close to subway and a 24h CVS next door. Free muffins and coffee every morning, stunning terrace bar and friendly staff. Wish I could spend more nights here.

title: Great Location
body: My wife and I just spent five nights at the Yotel. Located a few blocks from Times Square and subway stations, the Yotel is ideally situated for folks who want to hit the pavement. The Yotel is very hip and sleek. Rooms are extremely small but function well for two people. We also would not recommend for families with small children. After checking in (self check in via kiosk), we got to our room only to find the room not cleaned. After a phone call, we were given a clean room and a couple of $10 vouchers for bar/food. Room was on the 23rd floor with a view of the Hudson. Free muffins for breakfast if you choose. Coffee available 24/7. We only ate one meal at the Yotel and it was pretty good. Staff was very friendly and available when needed. The only downside, other than our room not being ready, was people smoking in the hallways at night. Smoke seemed to slip under our door into our room. Not cool! Overall, our room was booked five months in advance along with flight, so we go an excellent deal. We wouldn't hesitate to stay at the Yotel again.

title: Good location and price, terrible beds
body: The Yotel is very conveniently located and can be booked for a great price. Check-in and check-out are easy, the onsite restaurant is pretty tasty, and the round-the-clock free coffee is nice. The rooms are small but really well designed so that they don't feel claustrophic and there's lots of little shelves and nooks to put your things. The bed retracts up like a futon to help save space...and herein lies the problem. It's a great idea but it means the mattress is thin and on a hard retractable platform. These beds are seriously uncomfortable with no give and no cushioning. Also, the wireless was very hit or miss. I was here for a weeklong business trip so crappy wireless and uncomfortable beds were big negatives. That said, for location and price, I would at least consider this for a personal trip to NYC.

title: Great Deal for the Price!
body: My fiance and I booked this hotel for a Saturday and Sunday night trip into the city. After comparing multiple hotels, this appeared to be the best deal/location and I am so happy this was our final choice. Check in and check out were a breeze, as you do everything on computers in the lobby in less than a couple of minutes. As other reviews stated, the rooms are tiny and the beds are hard.. but this is honestly one of the cleanest hotel rooms I have ever stayed in and that made it worth it! The hotel also has an outdoor bar/lounge area on the fourth floor. This is a great place to have a drink before you head out for dinner or relax with the free coffee and muffins in the morning. I would absolutely recommend this hotel to family and friends and would not hesitate to stay there again in the future.

title: What was I thinking
body: What was I thinking all these years of staying in overpriced boring hotels. I don't want to leave. The staff is great, the food at the terrace was fantastic, the view is more than you could want I am right in midtown and I could not be happier with my room.. You have to build one of these in every major city. Will never stay in another hotel when I am in NY. Great job folks....

title: The Best Hotel - El Mejor de NYC!
body:
I stayed here with family and we loved it so much! Everything is so nice and bright and clean. Everyone is so friendly and nice, they give you anything you want here! We ask for a higher room and Simone gave it to my family no questions! She is so nice and funny, she really treats you as if you were a star, my mother adored her most. At night, we always talk to Noe and he will spend time with you to make sure everything is okay, he made maps for us through the computer, he teach me how to call home to Ecuador and he is so cool to talk to!
We had no complaints! Both my brother and mother loved it, and we think its really cool how so many people there speak everyone's language. Our room always clean, at this hotel, they will really spoil you. We not wanted to leave, but we will be returning for sure!

title: Nice and Affordable Surprise
body:
I stayed at this hotel in June for $160/night, which was significantly cheaper than other Manhattan hotels. The hotel is new, clean, and very comfortable. 
Before you book this hotel, you need to understand that you are reserving a "POD" hotel room. The room is essentially 150 square feet, which includes the bathroom. The bed doubles as a couch, and is similar to an electronic Futon (Bed wasn't comfortable by the way). The bathroom and bedroom are separated by a semi-transparent curtain. The hotel rooms would be too small for families or more than 2 people. Furthermore, if you are staying in the room with a friend or someone you are not close with, expect to lose bathroom privacy. If you are a couple or single person, this room is more than adequate as a hotel room.
There are a few positives to this hotel that I'd like to point out. 
-The hotel is right next to the Lincoln Tunnel, which makes it convenient for anyone driving into the City from Jersey. However, it is a good 10 minute walk to the heart of Times Square and the subway. 
-I loved the rooftop lounge, which had beautiful views! Make sure you go there.
-Free internet in all the rooms

title: Great Time At YOTEL NYC !!!
body: This place was fun. Shiny and new...boutique, chic, modern, clean, and secure. Great staff. Bar is full of attractive young people on the weekend. Can't wait to go back!!!

title: Hip and nice hotel!
body: This hotel is new, clean with a modern twist. The staff is mostly young, and is really friendly and helpful. The room is quite small, but well organised and nice looking. The bathroom, though, is only separated by a curtain, so I think it is more ideal for couples! And make sure you visit the rooftop lounge, which offers great views of the city! Walking distance from Times Square, with lots of great restaurants around! Highly recommended!

title: best hotel on my USA trip
body:
I stayed here with my one of my good friends while on a five week holiday from Australia. We stayed all up eight nights in Yotel while on our escapade in New York. Despite the bathrooms not having doors and the hotel rooms being a tiny bit squishy, we loved it. First and foremost, we loved the service (complimentary cupcakes and coffee in the morning, greeting smiles when we left or arrived back at the hotel, swift service when picking up a package and overall just a friendly, funky vibe), the lobby was great, the restaurant on the rooftop was really fun and the location was just about perfect! I celebrated my birthday on the Sunday of memorial weekend and just happened upon Yotel's amazing brunch. From 1:30 onwards we enjoyed endless amounts of delicious food and alcoholic beverages - a perfect way to spend a birthday! 
Overall, thank you Yotel for making our stay in New York enjoyable. If i ever make it back to that side of the world, i would definitely stay at Yotel again and i have already recommended it to friends and family!

title: All the essentials + some perks
body: As a reference, I've previously stayed at these Times Square area hotels: Marriott, Sheraton, W, Westin, Millennium & Hyatt. Chose Yotel for its proximity to the Javits Center, where I had a conference (<10 min walk); it's also within walking distance to Times Square & other touristy places. The room was small but made the most of the space (vs. some other hotels e.g. the W): floor-to-ceiling window, comfy bed, large flat screen TV, monsoon shower head, & free wifi (not common in NYC!). No coffee maker in the room itself but each floor has a galley kitchen with an excellent coffee machine (the cafe latte was as good as Starbucks!); free muffins in their 4th floor cafe; gym. BTW, they were offering deals through Travelzoo, but Tripadvisor's was even better. Opted for the cheapest room, but a few days before arrival, Yotel sent me an email offering an upgrade for $8 which was completely worth it (great view on the 26th floor!). Best of all, they had a clean room ready at noon (also very rare in my experience).

title: experience was good
body: So traveling to New York City, was very well. My mother and I stayed at Yotel, the place was very nice... modern! I rate the hotel very good, although the room was very small. Also I believe the cleaning people would turn off the air condition everytime they would clean. But besides those minor issues, this is a great place to stay! Also the Yotel Robot for luggage is very unique and very helpful! The robot allows you to drop your luggage off in a secure holding area and you can go explore the city without having to carry your luggage around the city.. waiting for your departure.

title: Nice Hotel - Great Service
body: Loved the very efficient manner in which we were directed to self-check in. Staff were always helpful and friendly. Room was on the 9th floor, and we had a lovely view of NY West. Quiet neighbourhood and we were not disturbed by noise in the street. Good hotel for walkers - about a block or two from subways, and relatively close for a nice walk to 46th/ 8-9Ave restaurants. Room was very clean and well appointed. No in room fridge, but there is a galley on each floor with a "community" fridge and microwave and coffee/hot chocolate machine. It was small - BUT having been in other NY hotels, I can say that it did not feel cramped at all. Water is free from the ice machine - which was very handy. Free muffins and coffee each morning on the 4th floor. It is very well laid out - if you are travelling with large suitcases there MAY be a space issue in the room (we only had two carry ons), but the hotel has a very interesting way to store large bags (check their website!). While the open concept room may not be great for family/friends travelling, there is a curtain to separate the bathroom area from the sleeping area (but I do agree with other reviewers that it is a set up that is best for couples who are quite familiar with each other! LOL). Only issue is that the mattress was quite unforgiving - it felt like an old feather mattress that had gone beyond its use ... but overall, I would not have any concern about staying here again.

title: So Cool!
body:
Plus - no hassel, self-check in, robot luggage handler, location, efficiency, towel warmers, views, terrace, tea/coffe galley on each floor, cleanliness, green philosophy, security, complimentary muffins & coffee/tea, friendly staff, terrace lounge and shower head...ahhh
Neg - bed was too hard, shampoo/soaps smelled medicinal, and were strong! Water from shower ended up on floor since there was no door. Techno music in all public places, very driving. Thermostat took long to adjust so we were either freezing or stifling for a long period of time.
Overall, very good experience. I recommend.

title: Great hotel and great experience
body: This was my 5th trip to NYC, but my wife's first. She found the hotel online and liked the modern look of it so this was our destination. I was very reserved about this hotel after some of the reviews I had read, but I have to say all the bad reviews seem to be unfounded. Yes the rooms are small, but your in NYC.. why are you wasting time in your room! We used the room for a few hours sleep each night, shower and get back on the streets. Use the room like you should any hotel room in NYC (stay out of them) and you don't realize or bothered by the size of the room. The breakfast was muffins and drinks and what realyl more do you need for free? You can order a regular breakfast is that's your desire, but grabbing a couple of muffins and a drink started our day perfectly. Plus with what you pay for everything else in NYC, taking advantage of ANYTHING you can find for free that is good is nothing to be passed up. The staff was very helpful and friendly. The only thing I can really say was an beating was the elevators. You go from the lobby to the 4th floor, have to get off and change elevators to go to your rooms. I assume this is because of space and possibly for security, but it was the only thing bad we could say about it. We are already planning our trip back next year, and Yotel is where we'll be at again. This place is pretty cool and fits perfectly for what is needed at a hotel in NYC.

title: pretty impressed
body: By the time i got in to new york (id taken the bus from toronto) i was so exhausted i just wanted to pass out. i walked from the port authority to the yotel which is clearly visible from miles away with its bright purple face. when you first walk in you are greeted by employees that are friendly, and helpful. checking in was super easy with their automated service. the hotel system is a little weird, and you have to go to the 4th floor (where the bar, resteraunt is) before you can anywhere else, but, whatever, minor inconvenience. when i got up to my (cabin) room, i had a ceiling to floor view of the hudson river and 10th street. the room is very tiny, but with all the necessities. if id been staying with someone it mightve beena bit weird with the bathroom situation, as the bathroom is not necissarily private. the 'wall' seperating it from the rest of the cabin is clear! i can imagine many couples making the most out of private resteraunt bathrooms during breakfast, as i would never wanna do my business in front of someone! lol. the bed was amazingly comfy, and i had time to catch a bit of the oscars on the large flat screen suspended from the wall before dozing off. the 'ncluded' breakfast really wasnt that great, coffee and a muffin, but with the prices for the rooms, im really lucky to get anything at all. the hotel is somewhat trendy and i felt a bit awkward heading in and out of my room at times due to all of the gorgeous young club kids hanging around, but thats ok too. the hotel is clean, private, safe, and wonderfully located. on top of all this, its extremely affordable, for any standards, not just new york. love the idea for the hotel and cant wait to stay in one again sometime.

title: Cool design, but less than responsive staff
body:
I have some pretty bad luck when I travel, but what separates the good hotels from the bad is how they handle the fixing.
