The best thing about Yotel was its location. It's located on 10th ave. on the edge of Hells Kitchen which has some great restaurants to eat at. It is also close to the subway, Times Square, Broadway and the river.

title: Great Staff!! Cute n Modern Hotel!!
body: Such a cute hotel with artdeco pizzaz!! The staff was friendly and helpful and the rooms were clean, small, but cute! Location was good and the checkout baggage machine in the downstairs lobby was so modern n cool! Great hotel!

title: Clean, Modern Hotel in heart of NYC
body: This was a very nice stay in the clean, modern hotel - Yotel. I like the sleek and modern style and we felt it convenient to Times Square and the Pier. nice prices, nice atmosphere, felt very hip and modern for a middle aged couple staying for their anniversary in NYC

title: Super awesome, Ikea-ish atmosphere
body: Yotel is a great place to stay; you get a lot for your money. Free breakfast (muffins, coffee and tea), and the outdoor patio is very comfortable. The atmosphere is very youthful and fun. We had a large party who needed an area to meet, and they have accommodated us in their very open and large lounging space. They also have rooms you can rent. I would stay again.

title: Yotel has something for everybody!
body:
Our stay at Yotel was nothing short of awesome. The cabins were modern and clean. The bathroom was amazing, spa-like. Access to computers at the main desk was a very nice touch. We brought our iPad and used the wifi throughout the hotel and in our room - very convenient.
The kids loved the Yobot, the flatscreen TV in our cabin, the galley (especially the hot chocolate), and the complimentary muffins in the morning. My husband and I thought the Yotel staff provided excellent service. The bed was incredibly comfortable. We felt we got great value for the price we paid. I loved the espresso and complimentary muffins.
There's nothing like a great trip that includes an excellent hotel stay!

title: Great hotel, especially for the price!
body:
We had a great time. The price was right, the room was clean and comfortable and the location was only 3 blocks from Time Square. It was a modern hotel but coffee, tea and water was always available and the free muffins in the morning were sufficient for our breakfast.
We walked almost everywhere! You have to be prepared to walk a lot. We walked north to Central Park, south to 34th St. to macy's and the Empire State Building but had to take a taxi to the 9/11 memorial. It was just too far.

title: YOTEL is a chic HOTEL!
body: Yotel is a great place to stay, I enjoyed discovering the cabin features, preferring a firm mattress enjoyed that too. I was there on a beautiful summer night and the terrace was an unexpected pleasure as well as the restaurant. Very cool vibe on the 4th floor and terrace. galley is convienient for expresso in the morning.

title: Best Hotel Choice this year
body: We just spent 4 days at the Yotel on 10th Ave. in NY.From the minute we arrived, the crew and service was exceptional.Every member of the staff was welcoming and helpful.The "cabin" as they call them, was just the right size.Immaculate room and hotel.Food exceptional and the hotel had a great hip, Euro vibe GREAT SUNDAY BRUNCH and DJ!.Very easy to get everywhere by foot, subway,bus.We got married in NY and this was the perfect place to have a honeymoon and very gay friendly. Emmanuel and Enoch could not have done more to make this best stay in NY.And the price and value were great.Will definitely stay again.We travel frequently so this was a great find!

title: 5 day stay in August 2012
body: Great, modern hotel. Convenient location. Rooms very clean (though compact!) with quiet air conditioning. Although full breakfast not included, free tea/coffee and muffins are available between 7 and 10 am.

title: AMAZING!!!
body:
I have just come back from New York this morning after staying in this hotel. This is the best value for money i have ever spent on a hotel. The check in and check out process took me about 30 seconds to 1 minute to complete. The staff are extremely helpful and made my stay complete. 
The location is ideal it is about 5-10 minutes walk from time square (depending on how fast a walker you are). This was great since it is close to the attractions but set away from the hustle and bustle of the city. In addition everything was free, i had to pay nothing, however i never used my telephone in the room, and complimentary breakfast is served from about 7-10am, even though it is just a muffin and coffee and tea, its still a great start to the day. We had a premium queen cabin with a folding bed/ sofa which was very comfortable indeed and the shower and toilet combination is not a problem since there are curtains which can be used in combination with the blinds.
The thing that i was most happy about besides being modern with a great appearance was the fact it was very clean with daily maid service. No dirt what so ever and not one bug in sight. We stayed on the 21 floor with a great view of upper Manhattan, a bit of New Jersey and a bit of time square, but no matter what floor you have you will have a great view.
This is really a great hotel, you wont regret staying here its amazing.

title: top notch hotel management
body: friendly crew and fantasic terrace; learned it was the largest for a hotel in all of NYC; most visitors from Europe; friendly atmosphere and very cordial; was staying on business and appreciated the quiet room and the good night's sleep; would recommend to friends and family

title: Great place to stay near midtown
body: Yotel is located very conveniently, at walking distance from Times Square. The rooms are small but very clean and well designed. Overall, the hotel provides good value for money considering the neighborhood. Minor points are the lack of privacy in the bathroom, and the complimentary breakfast. If you want something else than coffee or muffins, you have to pay (a lot).

title: Yotel, the flavour of New York
body: We have been in this fashion Hotel in New York by chance and found it very interesting. The atmosphere is "Young" in this stylish Hotel, with easy access (touch screen in the hallway) to register and concierge at fourth floor - FREE WIFI - very attentive people that introduce you to this no frills highly technological experience. Rooms are smaller than usual, but very cozy and interesting. Our room had a queen bed and an overhead bunker where our daughter could sleep. This best position this hotel for families, though they lack specific services for kids (no kids menu) but who cares? You are in New York! Recommend to see YOBOT in function, a robot that store your heavy to carry luggage. Great place also for aperitives parties and Sandoval's asian food reengineered is mouthwatering. Enjoy!

title: Not sure I'll go back
body:
Hmm. I just came back from a 3 night-stay at the NYC Yotel and I'm a bit ambivalent about it.
Everything was close to perfect. Recent hotel with modern and streamlined furniture, great layout of the rooms, 24-hour access to a galley on every floor (with free Lavazza coffee, water and ice and a small refrigerator), dynamic staff eager to help and a fantastic location that makes any airport transfer as easy as can be.
Unfortunately, there is a major jam in the elevators during rush hours and our room had a foul cigarette smell. I'm not afraid of a little dirt, but when I pay over 200 $ a night for a smoke-free room I expect I won't smell cigarette.
Pros:
- excellent location (close to Port Authority bus terminal -» easy airport transfer, 10 minutes walk to Times Square, 5 minutes walk to the High Line and many small restaurants and groceries.)
- rooms feel spacious because their layout is perfect
- great glass shower
- great views
- galley with free Lavazza coffee, ice and water and a refrigerator on every floor.
- excellent hotel for the independent traveller who doesn't need assistance (check in and out on your own)
- great staff
Cons:
- slow elevators during "rush hours"
- cigarette smell in the room
It turned out the ventilation air filter hadn't been change probably since the opening of the Yotel, last year... I choose not to post here the picture of the air filter but I urge you to check it upon arrival in your room. The one in our room was behind a small metal door right beside the bed.

title: Out of the ordinary...
body:
You have to stay at least once in your life at Yotel !!! The atmosphere, the design, the hi-tech rooms and the terrace make it a unique experience and worth the price. The location is great, the staff is friendly.
There are 2 little downsides : the mattress in our room wasn't the most comfortable of all (maybe it was only our room, but I doubt it) and it seemed next to impossible to catch an elevator between 9am and 10am...

title: Yotel New York: 5 stars!
body: We enjoyed our stay in New York City. It was a convient location. It had a neat, clean, and helpful staff. Our room was modern and very comfortable. We enjoyed the galley (especially the hot chocolate) and the morning muffins. We would've enjoyed the use of the terrace, but we weren't sure if we could use it without a food purchase, which we really weren't interested in making. A second restaurant that could've served more classic American meals would've been nice, since we ate our meals outside of the hotel. We loved the Yobot! It was well lit, and it was always clean - inside and outside. We enjoyed our stay and we hope to return to New York and the Yotel soon!

title: Ground Control to Major Tom!
body: Great feeling to the hotel, nice smell, decent sized rooms considering it is uptown Manhattan. Clean, good bar area for a relaxed night and all so modern. The hotels has a space ship theme going on that is really refreshing from the standard hotel style. The only drawback is that it is about 10-15 min walk to Times Square - but them again all the ones in the centre are the like of the Hilton and the Sheridan plus it is away enough from the centre to offer a good night's sleep without any noise.

title: Yotel New York - Fabulous, fabulous, fabulous
body:
We have just arrived back from a three night stay in new york, (we got married in central park while we were there!)
Upon arrival at the yotel we were welcomed in reception by Joanna who was fabulous, her customer service was excellent, and I can honestly say she is a real asset to the hotel, in fact the other staff we came across were brilliant too, the bar/restaurant manager (don't know her name) was also an absolute asset to the hotel and she made a point of coming over personally to see us after our wedding ceremony, we were given a bottle of champagne and cocktails as a gift in celebration of our wedding which we really appreciated. Our room was great, clean, bright, modern and the bed was so comfortable. Just to sum up the hotel was great, we will definately be coming back to the Yotel.

title: Very modern, clean and well maintained hotel
body: We stayed for 3 nights in this hotel, we had 3 rooms. We were very impressed with every facility the hotel offered, the welcome at booking in was second to none, the guy put our luggage on a trolley and took it up to our room for us, and showed us how everything worked in the bedroom. The bedrooms are called cabins, and very compact and bijou. there was a wide screen tv, a free safe deposit, fantastic shower and free toiletries, we were on the 24th floor and had a fantastic view of New York. There was a room down the coridoor where you could get free tea, coffee, hot chocolate and iced water. Tea, coffee and muffins were free at breakfast time, and you could sit in the roof garden and eat breakfast. it was only a short walk to times square, so very central. the beds were very comfy and when you pressed a button the bed folded back to make more room. We were very impressed and would definitely go back to this hotel.

title: High-tech, unique, but . . .
body:
I chose Yotel for its uniqueness. My seven-year-old and two-year-old sons loved having bunkbeds, and the purple lights and high-tech look of the place made it quite different from the average (or even extraordinary) hotel in most places. Rooms are small, but efficient and interesting (in some smaller rooms, bed can be electrically moved to provide a backrest).
What is perhaps not so surprising is that the high-tech doesn't work all that well. You enter the first-floor lobby and are greeted (in theory) by a bank of computers. Needless to say, most folks will stand in the middle of the room and stare. As a result, there is a small army of attendants to take you to a computer, help you find your reservation, show you how to print a room card and produce room keys. In other words, technology is primarily decorative.
The minuses? The automatic revolving door starts and stops unexpectedly. Going in, you'll bump your nose when someone enters going out. My wife got caught when it stopped with the stroller she was pushing in the next space and she tried to reach it as it started up again. In other words, high tech that doesn't always work. Did the hotel offer any TLC to soothe things? It asked if she wanted to go to the hospital and showed her where a bathroom was to wash the grease off her arm. Of course they thought of lawsuits, not customer service.
The room had cool shades that work from a button, but the lights are tricky. Want to go to the bathroom? You have to go to the front door to make the light work. The bathroom door was glass, untrimmed, so a hazard to feet (particularly children). In our room, the strip attached to the concrete wall of the bathroom, necessary to latch or lock the door, was missing. So, if you want privacy in the bathroom, good luck. The shower (no bath) is large, but the floor is higher than the rest of the bathroom -- so water runs to the other wall (nothing to prevent it).
They offer a reasonably nice muffin and coffee/tea in the morning. The first day they ran out of half-and-half for coffee and then ran out of muffins. In the process, lines became longer and longer. The design of the breakfast service was a single long line, so anyone delayed at any point for any reason caused the whole line to backup.
Despite this, I thought it was a fun place. The food in the restaurant (snack-size, a la carte at around $10 a small plate) was excellent. It is just off 42nd Street, a fun place to walk, and it is about 30 seconds from Lincoln Tunnel heading south if you are driving . . . well, 30 seconds from the line for Lincoln Tunnel anyway. Parking is in the building, but entrance is on another street.

title: Walk everywhere location
body:
Very clean and modern, and lets face it, your not in NYC to sit in a hotel room, and if you are your in the wrong city.
Yotel was in a fabulous location , we walked everywhere!!! over the 8 nights we were there. Its close to the bus station the subway station, there is a pharmacy a bank and supermarket right accros the road. The coffee machine on every leve was a godsend and we would just fill up our water bottles there everyday for our long walks ahead. Bout 5 min walk to times square (if thats your thing) and right in the heart of Broadway and resturant row. 
About 15 minutes south walk to fashion districk where manhattan mall, macys, large Old navy and heaps of others are.
Staff are healpfull and will hail a cab when you need and help with directions if you need that too. 
Heaps of power points in the room and the full size shower is great. 
Only good things to say about our stay there, 
Try looking on their facbook page for deals and specials, we got 15% off with a code on their page

title: Marie -Quirky hotel
body: I just loved this hotel.I booked this hotel for a 2 night break with my daughter. It was so quirkiy and modern. Staff were so helpful when we arrived for the futuristic check in. Our 'cabin' (room) on the 11th floor was lovely and bright and airy. I liked the ultraviolet lighting. The cabin was smaller than other hotel rooms but there was space for everything. I liked the way the bed could be moved from sofa position to full bed. This also created adequate space underneath for storage of luggage. Level 4 was so cool. Super outside area to have complimentary breakfast muffins and coffee or a drink in the evening. Brilliant location near to the bus station and easy walking distance to Times Square. Lots of restaurants in Hells Kitchen area nearby. Would definitely go back to this hotel.

title: The ONLY Place to Stay in NYC
body: Wonderful hotel, I would recommend it to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in New York. The cleanliness, safety and good value-for-money where just the foundations fo the great experience we had at Yotel. From the modern design and funky purple room lighting, to the chill-out music playing in the lobby and fantastic views across the city from the glass bathroom, this was my idea of a perfectly designed hotel. Combine this with the great value restaurant and cool, relaxed terrace bar, and I wouldn't think twice about staying in Yotel again! Thank you for such a great experience.

title: great hotel
body: stunning hotel, great views and a lovely clean, modern room. the rooms are small but oh so stylish. they are stark white and everything about them screams chic. Staff were helpful and friendly. great location for walking around the entire city , but taxis pas the front if walking is not for you .

title: Yotel in New York City
body: This hotel is ultra modern and a bit quirky. The rooms really are cabin size (small) but so well designed that they are comfortable, including the bed that partially retracts upright. It was spotlessly clean and had a lovely outdoor patio for drinks. It is close to the Lincoln Tunnel so there is not much city driving to get there and has a garage. It is walking distance to the theatre district and bunches of restaurants on 9th. The Marseilles fFrench restaurant on 9th was excellent. It was also less expensive than many New York hotels. The robot apparatus for storing luggage is not to be missed.

title: Some excellent parts but some let downs - would recommend though.
body:
We stayed here for a week in August - The hotel itself is wonderful and I would recommend it purely for its location. a 5-10min walk to the heart of times square, or the piers along the coast in the opposite direction. A two minute stroll to 9th Ave were there are hundreds of excellent eateries! The cabin was small and lacked privacy, but was very clean and was fine for what you need it for. Staff were fine and helpful enough.
On a negative note the bar was ridiculously expensive, I payed around $25 for a small gin and tonic and a mojito, neither were anything worth bragging about compared with other locations in NYC. My main gripe was that me and my girlfriend got engaged in NY and her mom had phoned the hotel up and arranged for a bottle of champagne to be sent to room - a lovely gesture, but it never arrived. It had all been agreed on the phone and the card transaction taken over the phone, only to never actually arrive at our room. A disapointing flaw in customer service that tarnished an otherwise ideal trip.

title: Absolutely Amazing.
body:
I travel quite a bit for work, and while i've never felt compelled to leave any reviews, I have to say this place really is the outlier. Firstly, let me say, the property is really beautiful and unique, and for its price point, amazing. And just in that aspect alone, you'll never find another. The facilities are great, although I didn't have the opportunity to use them, the value this place offers makes it outstanding. I really hope to see more of these properties open up, they'll give other brands a run for their money.
What's really important about this place goes beyond the physical. The staff is unmatched. At first, I was unimpressed, the entire facade seemed very shallow, with the staffing being very attractive kids. I am one of those independent travelers that like to do things on my own, and let me say, the people on the first floor couldn't be any happier to help. I didn't catch any of their names, but they're great. On the 4th floor, there is Mission Control, and I have to say, they were the best front desk staff i've ever had the pleasure of encountering. I didn't interact with them much, but Dahyana in the morning was so patient with me when I had issues with billing. I was being very curt, yet she was able to explain everything and with a smile. It made me catch myself.
One night I was returning from a conference really late, and as I was exiting the elevator, I slipped and dropped my candy bar on the floor, scrapping it away. The young man, who I believe was named NJ(?) showed immediate concern, which was to be expected, but when I returned from the bathroom and made my way to the elevators to get to my "cabin," he stopped me to offer some of his Jelly Beans. This was such a kind gesture. I stood there for a couple minutes talking about the hotel and listening to him share stories about how clumsy he is. What could have been a very embarassing situation turned into authentic connection.
This place has the most genuine staff you'll ever meet. Some of these reviews of negativity, those people must have been out of line, the staff here will make you never want to stay anywhere else again.

title: Nice Hotel
body:
I like the concept design of Yotel. Nice hotel if you are staying for couple of days. My only concern was the cleanliness of the shower; there was a hair-ball stuck in the shower's drain. The Air Conditioner was not cooling. We had to call the reciption and they took care of both issues. On our last night the A/C was not cooling for the second time - we stayed for 3 nights total. 
The water pressure was not great but the shower gels were the best.

title: Small cabins but very cute and funky
body: We went to NYC this August and this time we stayed at this design hotel on 42nd Steet in Hells Kitchen. I must say, despite the small cabin (room) I liked the hotel very much, it was contemporary, clean, very practically arranged cabins, perfect bathrooms. I also liked the terrace on 4th floor where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner or just few drinks...the terrace was very spacious and had a nice atmosphere. I am very picky and posh but I would definitely recommend this facility.

title: EXCELLENT STAY -Can hardly wait to go back!
body:
A very funky hotel just slightly outside of the craziness of Times Square. Fabulous complimentary coffee and muffins in the morning on a beautiful terrace - a galley kitchen on each floor equipped with water, ice and a coffee/latte/hot choco machine, available 24 hours a day - impeccable rooms with AMAZING views of the NY skyline (small but SO bright and clean, you get used to it) - a well equipped gym.
Our experience at the YOTEL was fabulous. The staff that greeted us at the front door were extremely helpful. they took our luggage at 6am so that we could go exploring before we checked in at 3pm. When we checked in on the 4th floor, the staff, one girl in particular, wasn't as friendly, or as helpful, but still ok. Everything else was great. We LOVED our room but in retrospect, really wished we had upgraded to the corner suite. We asked a custodian on our floor about an ice bucket, and he immediately went somewhere to get us one. WOW! Our phone had some technical difficulties, and even though they never did fix it, the service person that came in at 11pm was also extremely nice.
We can hardly wait to YOTEL NYC again!!!!

title: Yotel Wedding
body: Our stay was great. This place is more for the younger crowd, but all our guests had great service. The rooms are small but very cool. The hotel is very clean and the service staff could not be more helpful. Outdoor terrace bars are a great way to end the day.

title: Amazing modern hotel
body: We booked a last minute trip to New York and as Yotel was coming in at a great price and based on Tripadvisor reviews we booked it. Check in was so easy, we arrived at 1.30pm and our cabin was ready. The rooms are small however so well designed to use the space to best effect. The team at mission control were really helpful when we wanted a late check out. There was a selection of muffins tea and coffee available in the morning. It was really close to Port Authority, Hell's Kitchen and Time Square. We have stayed in a number of hotels in New York and would stay at the Yotel again.

title: Loved it, Loved it, Loved it!!!
body:
We stayed at Yotel between the 30th of August '12 and the 5th of September '12 and absolutely loved it!! 
We arrived at the hotel early, however the staff on level 4/mission control managed to check us in early to our cabin - excellent customer service!! Our cabin was immaculate (as was the rest of the hotel) and although the actual size of the room initially looked a little small, it was perfectly formed. It had everything we needed and was cleverly designed. We had plenty of space for our belongings and managed to make ourselves right at home! The bed was very comfortable and the shower was hot and powerful. There was a safe in the room which was perfect for leaving our valuables while we were out and about. There is a galley on each floor which is great with complimentary tea, coffee, hot chocolate, water and ice etc, and there were muffins available every morning which were delicious. The hotel's location is ideal. It's within walking distance to Times Square and Port Authority Bus Terminal, and it was easy to get around.
We are thinking about returning to New York again next year and would definitely stay at Yotel again.

title: Great!
body: Traveled in mid August 2012, I had a great experience at Yotel.. Staff was nice and warm.. liked the proximity to Times Square. Clean rooms. Modern decor. I got a great deal through TravelZoo so it was a great value. I would return to this hotel next time I am in New York City, no doubt.

title: Cool Hotel
body: What can we say that hasn't been said already? We just had the pleasure of staying here for 4 nights and loved the place. As soon as we stepped out of the taxi we were greeted by one of the many employees. He was very friendly and helpful and didn't leave our side until we were in our room. The room did look small when we arrived but it was fine. After all who goes to NYC to spend a lot of time in their hotel room? We had so much planned for our trip that we ended up not spending a lot of time in the hotel at all. The only small criticism we would have is that we didn't know about the free muffins and tea/coffee until our last morning! We went out and bought breakfast each morning.

title: Best hotel ever!
body:
The location is perfect, the crew is great and the hotel is AMAZING!! Loved it! Will never stay at another hotel in NY, this is the one!
It is a brand new hotel, very modern and practical. There was a kitchen at my floor that can be used 24/7 with free water, espresso, tea, etc.
The breakfast had a nice selection of muffins, coffee and tea (included in stay).

title: Super Hotel!!! Great location!
body:
Great hotel, great location. Subway is nearby, also Time Square. You get free coffee and tea every morning with a fresh muffin. Also you have free coffee, tea and water on every floor.
Staff is very friendly. We've been there for 9 days and had an amazing time. Rooms are perfect and clean. 
The check inn is very easy and you could be helped with one of the staff. You don't hear any noise from outside. I would definitely go back to this great hotel!

title: Small, practical, good location - but more of a nightclub than hotel
body:
Booked this hotel for me and my wife (both 30+) after some friends stayed there mostly because of the location and that the price was alright compared to lots of the alternatives.
However I doubt I will come back and stay at Yotel
The staff are very friendly and the rooms are clean, but it seems as if this hotel cannot make up its mind of wheter it is a nightclub or a hotel and to be honest I did not like the combination of the two they are trying to create.
Coming home after a day of shopping or a romatic dinner and being forced to hurdle through crowds of young people with extremely loud music when the reception and restaurant is transformed into a noghtclub was not for us.
The 19-year old me would have loved it, but as most of the hotel-guests seemed to be in our age and above and all the club-guests seemed to be much younger and not staying at the hotel the combination is just annoying.
The rooms are super-small, but works ok because of the smart sollutions.
We paid extra for a view and since this was our first visit to NYC I had hopes of being able to enjoy this view from the room or even the bed, but since the only window was next to the shower and toilet where you need to have the curtains closed since there are lots of opposite buildings with a direct-view to the room we almost had no use of the view.

title: Hotel Yotel, The Place To Be!
body: Just got home yesterday from a GREAT visit to New York City. Stayed at the Yotel for 4 nights. As if NYC isn't enough of an experience, staying at the Yotel became part of the fun instead of it just being a place to crash at the end of the day. Firstly, it was unlike any other hotel I had stayed at. The designers incorporated so many technological, and ecofriendly features, that even a newly renovated hotel probably couldn't match! The vibe is very young and hip, but still works great for business or solo travel. The particular room I stayed in would have been fine if my husband joined me, but if our 7 year old daughter came along, we'd have to change the type of room we stayed in. One of the things that made the stay so pleasurable was how smart everything was - they anticipated everything, even down to the cable to plug your mp3 player in so you could broadcast through the tv! When I got to my room, I'm glad I read about all the little features - I might have missed the towel warmer and storage space feature under the bed! So, while the room was small, it was so efficient that there was plenty of room - even after a day of shopping in the city! The floor I stayed on had a 24/7 galley which had a coffee/coca/hot water/espresso machine, a microwave and water machine (ice, ice and water, just water). Next, the breakfast in the morning consisted of different coffee's (delicious), hot teas, and a lovely assortment of muffins (not the store bought mini-muffin like things many other hotels serve). It was a great way to start the day with something light. However, one morning, I was relaxing and wanted a hot meal, so I sat in the restaurant part and ordered off the menu (this you pay for, the coffee/muffins are free) - loved that I had a choice. Also appreciated that they have computer stations set up - I was able to start up a free 30 min. session - it was so convenient because I didn't bring my computer with me. It was especially helpful when it was time to leave and I was able to print my boarding pass! I could go on and on, but overall, they really thought this design through. It's by far the coolest place out there, and surprisingly, was the least expensive! It's officially 'my hotel' when I go to NYC!!!!! I would recommend you at least try it for the experience - I don't think you'll be disappointed! And hey, where else can you stay that has a robot that will store your luggage for you?! ENJOY!!!!

title: A perfect stay at the Yotel
body: The Yotel is well located, juste a fiew minute walk to time square and subways! The room was perfectly clean! Coffee is available all day long on each floor! The morning chocolat muffins are delicius. The Bed is as comfortable as home! Internet speend was perfect... We will sure go back in our next New York trip!

title: Lovely Hotel
body:
Stayed at the Yotel for 4 nights at the beginning of September with 8 friends. The place is fab, check-in was quick, the staff are lovely, very friendly and helpful ensuring that our rooms were all together without us even having to request it. The hotel is very modern and minimalistic, yobot is fascinating, having seen the hotel on the Gadget Show we were very excited by all it's mod-cons. The rooms are small (apparently all rooms in New York are compact), however the design and layout of the room is great, the bed folds up and out electronically which is a great space saver. The streets outside are noisy but the sound proofing is great and once you shut the window you can't hear anything. The air conditoning was great and very quiet (which is often a novelty) in previous hotels I've stayed in. I don't think I've had a better nights sleep whilst staying at Yotel.
The dining area, bar and outside patio area are lovely, the drinks are a bit on the expensive side but then you are in New York and the GBP hasn't been too good against the $.
The reason I didn't give it 5 stars (and i was tempted) was the bathroom situation, it's in a closed off section of the room and no real privacy to it so you either have to know the person your sharing with quite intimately or you will have to ask them to leave the room if you do want some privacy!
We thought the location was good and within a short distance to Times Square and a good base for the sub-way to get around New York.
Thank you for making our stay in New York an enjoyable experience, I would definitely stay here again.

title: So unique
body: I don't know why some people complain about the beds, I have slept so well these last three days. I am highly impressed by this hotel, I love the atmosphere they have created in the rooms, with the lights and how everything is designed. The staff is always willing to help. I got a premium view room and the views were fantastic. The location is also good, really, I cannot say anything wrong, cleanliness, top design, good value, comfort, incredible staff. I have been to five star hotels way worse than this hotel with not so many stars. I would recommend Yotel Times Square to everyone.

title: central place in NYC
body:
The location of this Yotel is very convenient to explore Hell's Kitchen, Midtown, Chelsea and Clinton by foot. 2 jogging tours along Hudson river are only two blocks away (the fitness area is very limited cardio-wise with 2 treadmills, 2 steppers, and a rowing machine).
Our room on the 24th floor was rather small but the space was well used. Lack of space for clothes for 2 people staying longer (6 nights). The complementary muffins for breakfast are ok and the additional dishes to order taste very good and are not that expensive.
All in all: casual atmosphere, nice staff, functional rooms, good concept!

title: Nearly perfect :)
body:
Stayed at Yotel from Sept 1-4th. love their concept. Emmanuel showed us how to check-in and led us to our room with all the features explained. very impressed with the absolutely excellent customer service Yotel provided. Love the atmosphere as its a very hip & more to young people hotel. don't mind the "no room service, fridge" yadi yada within the room. since that is what makes Yotel priced reasonably. Bed was SO COMFY? (read alot of people complaining) I felt like its the comfiest bed ever with the highest quality bed sheet. very VERY impressed. Meanwhile I am very happy with almost everything, there are two minor issues i want to point out. 
Although room (we stayed at 1011) was cleaned everyday, there were mildew all along the shower which was abit disappointing. And the design of the shower stall actually needed abit of improvement as water keep splashing out to the toilet side (its separated by a glass wall to save space). no big deal though. another thing is our AC wasn't working properly throughout our stay. we had it on and in the middle of the night cold air wasn't coming out so we called mission control, someone came (within 10 mins, impressive) and turned it off and back on and it was fine. but the same thing happened next night and we woke up by the hotness in the room, since i don't like to bother people i turned it off myself. other then these two things everything was perfect. would definitely recommend to young couple :) Thank you yotel for giving me a very pleasant stay!

title: As usual good stay
body:
Free WIFI, stay with Style with this cool hotel. very good service by the local staff. OK size rooms, Good lounge and the Gallery in every floor is one of the best thing ever!
Try to get a bigger room in the sides of the hotels

title: Friendly & comfortable young hotel
body: Good place for young couples.....bar/resturants ....great muffins in the morning! The area is not the best....althought it's very central...so it's easy to get around! Try the sushi ... It's quite good!

title: best hotel in NYC!!! YOTEL
body: stayed four nights in the yotel with my husband on our first trip to NYC, we were so pleased and happy with our stay. the staff were friendly and happy to help. our rooms were always clean, had amazing views from our room! and most defitnately would book again with them!! loved it xx

title: Great stay at stylish hotel!
body:
Stayed here for 6 nights in the beginning of September.
When we arrived, the computer did not find our reservation, but someone came to help us straight away, the company who booked the room spelled my name wrong, so that was the problem. We arrived around 3PM and we could enter our room immediately. Very nice and cosy room, with comfy bed and nice TV. The only thing that bothered me a little bit was that the shower is not that powerful...
The muffins and coffee/tea in the morning are really great. If you like hot chocolate milk, just visit the galley on your floor before going down and take one with you to the breakfast.
We liked the location, very close to times square (5min walk) and subway station (port authority bus terminal).
One night the fire alarm went off, but there was no emergency and the hotel communicated this very well through their speaker system. It wasn't their fault, so we weren't bothered.

title: Great place to stay in NY!
body:
Awesome and quiet room, awesome view!
I'll definitely stay there again, close to Times Square, room has all the amenities you'll need and it's very functional.
I didn't mind the size of the room, but might throw some visitors off.

title: Superbe!
body:
Wonderful hotel ! very nice staff. just a pretty room, with a confortable bed :) 
Not a lot of noise and just an amazing view from our room ! It's very very close to Times Square, approximately 10 minutes by foot. And also close to Central Park (10-15 min ).

title: Business Trip
body: This was my first trip to NY and it was for business. I was very nervous as I hear so many bad things about the NY hotels and the cleanliness of the rooms. This hotel was so clean and very cool. Stayed two nights for business. Clean, fresh and very hip! The lobby smelled amazing! You will know what I mean when you arrive! I will be back to this Yotel!

title: Excellent stay in New Yorks Yotel Hotel
body: Excellent hotel to stay in New York for the money! Free coffee and muffins are great in the mornings! Really clean rooms and modern hotel that is about a 10 minute walk to Times Square. Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to New York!

title: Great Hotel, Great Location
body: My wife and I stayed here for 7 nights during our honeymoon in mid July. When we arrived, we tried to check in at the computer kiosks but it could not find my name. A staff member quickly took us to the 4th floor where he stayed with us till our reservation was found. He even walked us up to our room, he didn't like the view for us so he took us back downstairs to get us another room with a great view of the Hudson. We loved the cozyness of the rooms. Yes they are small but who cares, we were in NYC to enjoy the sights and shows. I will say that our comforter was pretty disgusting. It had numerous stains on it. It was gross, but we called downstairs and a staff member quickly brought us a brand new comforter still in the bag and opened it right in front of us to show us it was new. The location of this place is awesome, especially if you want to check out some broadway shows. We walked to the theaters. There are plenty of great restaurants with a few blocks and with the metro 2 blocks away, you can get anywhere you want. We enjoyed our stay so much, we just booked another 6 night stay.

title: Fancy hotel and good location - but bed was hard as rock.
body: I found the location good and the hotel was fancy and all that - but it doesn't help when the bed is pretty much impossible to sleep in. The rooms (or the cabins) are small, and when I say small I mean SMALL. I don't mind small hotel rooms at all, but I like to move around without having to trip over my suitcase. Or to even fit my suitcase inside of the hotelroom without struggling Sizewise did it feel like a boat cabin -I could survive the lack of space for three days, but didn't sleep good at all (I would almost have been the same to sleep on the floor). Clean and fancy hotel + good location, but it doesn't make up for the quality and lack of sleep due to terrible beds.

title: Fun quirky hotel in a good location
body:
Stayed for a week with my boyfriend in a standard cabin and having scoured reviews before we left, I was afraid that the rooms would be tiny and the beds uncomfortable as per some reviews. Thankfully this wasn't the case; we slept really well and loved moving the bed out every night. If you have large amounts of luggage you may find it a little cramped, but I was surprised how well thought out most aspects of the room's design were as they facilitated storage in clever ways. Bathroom wasn't as bad as I expected though you probably would prefer a little more privacy in an ideal world. 
We only had minor negative points; a few of the staff were not the most helpful but we thankfully didn't have to deal with them too much. The door opens inwards into the room so you need to be careful when opening the drawers directly beside the door if anyone's likely to walk in! The phone kept blinking a light throughout the night which was a bit distracting, despite having no messages waiting for us. The safe is very narrow (laptop safe) which meant we couldn't fit our SLR camera into it. Every morning you'd be woken around 8am by housekeeping knocking on other doors in the corridor and you really can hear virtually EVERYTHING from the hall itself so we got a fit of the giggles when we arrived back one afternoon to hear one of our neighbours being loudly amorous! Once you're in your room though you are less aware of outside noises so it's not really an issue. Due to the nature of materials used (lots of plastic etc) I think unfortunately some of the fittings used in the rooms aren't going to age particularly well. Our shower floor already looked a bit scuffed, the plugs were liable to pop out of the wall if pulled at all and our ironing board had been burnt quite badly by a previous occupant. Most of the room still looks good though and it does have a nice modern, spacey vibe. 
Overall YOTEL exceeded our expectations. It was affordable, clean, close to all the midtown action and had everything you could want. I loved that the hairdryer, iron and wifi were all part of the standard package and the floor to ceiling windows gave you an amazing view over the city both morning and night. As we were there for 7 days, I was a bit worried it'd feel claustrophobic but we felt really at home and relieved to get back there after a long day sight-seeing etc. I LOVED the galley. We didn't end up eating the muffin breakfast any of the mornings because we liked the convenience of grabbing coffee from the machine and whatever we'd bought the night before in the communal fridge for breakfast in bed. It was lovely being able to get ice & water anytime you liked and have a free cup of camomile tea before bed. Like the best part of a hostel/self-catering within the comfort of a hotel! We'd definitely go back and recommend it to friends.

title: Great place to stay
body: This hotel was a great choice - the staff were helpful and friendly, and the hotel itself was a great location. Yes, the room was small (similar to a ship cabin) but fine. The one oddity was the bathroom which has no separate door - just a see-through curtain, so forget about privacy. (We were 3 friends sharing, and just took turns leaving the room). But we did have a fantastic view of the Empire State Building from our window!! That was incredible. And the location was perfect - Times Sq, many great restaurants and even the theatre district were in walking distance. I would def stay at this hotel again.

title: Yotel September Trip - Spot on
body:
Could not fault the hotel whatsoever. Staff were always very down to earth and made everything easy and seamless.
The room was slightly cramped but everything was situated well enough that you didn't need a lot of room. A part from that an excellent hotel all round.
Free wifi that had superb strength, free hot drinks, ice and water on every floor. Would definitely recommend Yotel New York and would definitely use it again.
Thanks.

title: Wonderful honeymoon stay at Yotel
body: Great hotel, modern and close to Times Square. Loved how fast and easy check-in and check-out was. Friendly staff, very helpful and efficient. My new husband and I would definitely stay there again. Only thing was the mattress of our standard cabin was a bit hard for our liking but we were still able to have 4 great nights sleep.

title: Has to be the funkiest hotel in New York - love it!
body:
This hotel made our stay in New York. From the moment we arrived and walked into the lobby and checked in to walking into our room and being confronted with the amazing view from the floor to ceiling windows, we fell in love with this hotel. The windows have roller blinds that are operated by a switch by the bed. You can lie in bed in the morning and open the blinds without having to get out of bed. Pretty amazing at 5am watching the sun come up when you are jet lagged!!! There was a galley right next door where we could get coffee and water at any time. Again, great at 5am! The bed was comfy, I am stealing the bathroom design for my own house and it was all very clean and quiet. 
The website says they have muffins available for breakfast. What I didn't expect was to go down in the (disco) lift: step out into the lobby where they play birdsong and then go round to a big selection of muffins and free tea and coffee or you can buy breakfast if you want. Then out on to the terrace to eat your breakfast surrounded by the buildings and noise of morning Manhattan. The sun shone every day for us, which was a big help!
We had cocktails on the same terrace bar on the first night, which was really busy (Thursday night). The other 3 nights seemed to be a lot quieter. 
The location is very good - just 3 or 4 blocks from Time Square. It is also very close to Port Authority train and bus station so you can catch the subway easily, which we did over to Brooklyn one day.
This is the most amazing hotel and I would recommend anyone to stay here.

title: The awesome Yotel
body:
Yotel is a great hotel to stay at when you visit NY. 
It's a modern, wel located hotel that offers nice rooms and a great service.
Staff are friendly and helpful and everything is done very efficiently. You can freely use the 4 computers at missin control and there is free wifi (that works) true out Yotel. The hotel is close to Times Square, the High Line and the amazing Pacha club.

title: awesome view
body: Get an Executive View Cabin for a truly special view (but remember to bring a robe because it's really, um, exposed). The room really does have everything that's needed and feels quite spacious. The mattress was a bit hard but not awful, and the bathroom could use a couple of shelves, but the crew is very friendly and helpful and the hotel is a good value.

title: Excellent, modern and hip hotel.
body: The hotel's interior was very exciting and aesthetically pleasing. Comfort-wise it had everything we needed and nothing superfluous. Really liked all the small details that came together to make our 7-night stay very pleasant. There is always helpful staff on hand. AC in the rooms is louder than advertised, but still reasonable. Two blocks to the nearest subway station. One of the best hotels I have stayed at. Great value.

title: Idealistic Yotel
body: The self service hotel is a worth the money. Clean, comfortable and a great location. The rooms are simple but elegant. One should be comfortable when sharing a room as the toilet was not a located in a separate room. This is was certainly not an issue for my partner and I. The view was fantastic. The hotel has a great atmosphere about it and I could clearly see the other guests were pleased with the hotel. When we return to New York, we will of course return to the great Yotel. Enjoy.

title: great stay
body:
Beautiful modern hotel near to Times Square.
Small but very nice rooms. Wouls definately stay there again.

title: Yotel was just right for us
body: We did a quick girls trip to NYC in August/12. We got a good deal on Yotel through a TravelZoo special. The location was convenient and the staff were always willing to assist us with anything we needed. The rooftop patio/bar was a really neat touch, although the drinks were quite pricey. My bag was too large for the Yobot to store, but a human staff member was happy to do it for me. The room was perfect. It was small but very nicely set up and very neat and tidy and had everything we needed. Felt very much like a stateroom on a cruise ship. For the amount of time we spent there, it was just perfect. A nice comfy bed to sleep in and a nice shower to clean up. As others have written, the bathroom does not offer a great deal of privacy, but there is a curtain that can be drawn for a little more privacy than what just the glass walls offer. The concierge happily arranged for us to have an airport limo pick us up at the hotel to go to LGA which ended up costing less (between our group) than the regular taxi cost from LGA to Yotel. I wouldn't hesitate to choose Yotel for a return trip.

title: All was very good
body:
The location was convenient and the staff were very available. The Galley was great! Clean, comfortable with a great location. The rooms are simple but elegant. One should be comfortable when sharing a room as the toilet was not a located in a separate room
Viky from BS

title: A Birthday Treat
body: First time trip to N.Y.C! To celebrate ny wife's 60th Birthday. We loved the Yotel !! .. We found the rooms more than adequate, clean and met all our needs!! There are so many unique spaces to check out - the Galley was unique - the Terrace Bar is great, We ate there a few times - the food was amazing! Crew were all super helpful and friendly. We will return for sure to the Yotel and I am spreading the word to anyone I talk to.

title: Urban experience in NYC
body:
Ok, you are in New York, so don't expect large rooms here. Yes, the room is tiny, but everything has been thought to make it convenient and comfortable. The sofa turns out to a bed, the bathroom's mirror has its own lighting system, you can easily plug you're electronic device on the mural TV system to listen to your favorite music, etc. And the design of the room and of the hotel itself makes it an excellent choice to live a real urban experience. This was probably the nicest view I ever had in a bathroom ! I can imagine what it would have been if we had a room on a higher floor (we were on the tenth). We loved the choice of shampoo/shower gel (one for the morning, one for the night) so much that we bought a bottle to bring home.
At our arrival, we use the automated check-in, and we stored our luggage with the famous robot in the lobby on the day we checked-out. How innovative ! Also, the terrace bar is really nice and the drinks are good. The location is perfect, only a short walk from Times square and also from the Highline.
It was our fourth stay in NYC and Yotel was definitely the best hotel we stayed in. Will surely stay there on our next trip.

title: Neat and clean
body: The YOTEL was perfect for a couple taking a weekend trip. I loved this hotel the rooms were small but had all the amenities you need to feel comfortable. Once you step through the doors you are greeted by well mannered staff that’s willing to assist you with the computerized check in & the YOBOT stores your luggage in clear view, just imagine watching a robot pack your luggage. This hotel is very relaxing despite being in the middle of the city. Be care full if you drive your car or SUV be prepare to pay $ 30-$40 for parking per day.

title: You can't find better for the price
body: For NYC it doesn't get any better than this for the price. Prime location, well appointed rooms, fastest check in/out ever. Hallways a bit loud though. Breakfast bar was good. Overall: Happy people, modern concept, great stay! We'll be back

title: Beware: overpriced, very poor service, housekeeping staff exceptionally loud & noisy at 7am
body: We checked in Sept 19/12 2 rooms for 4 people, this is not a cheap hotel particularly given the bad service. The smell upon entering the hotel is nauseatingly overpowering & continues in the elevators up to the 4th floor where "mission control" is located. The rain shower head decided to "rain" repeatedly most of the first night. Can't close the door as it is just a glass enclosure around the shower stall & toilet & was not up to moving at 12:30am so piled towels on the floor. The bathroom sink didn't drain which they fixed but it continued to drip so just applied more towels. There is no room service & any request to get more towels took 3 calls and a wait of 2 hours. The last set of towels were stained and shredded (did not use). The most offensive thing was the inconsiderate housekeeping staff, 3 of them talking so loudly to each other at 7am on Sat Sept 22nd right outside our door it woke us both up. This continued for some time until I stuck my head out & politely asked them to be quiet but they still continued to talk extremely loudly (the doors are not soundproof unfortunately) and I was very unhappy when I asked them to be quiet for the second time. They just laughed. I called "mission control" who said they would talk to housekeeping. Big deal they gave us 4- $10 coupons for food. I would have preferred to talk to a manager to negotiate a better rate for those dreadful nights but they hustle you down to the ground floor to use the automated check out so that you can't actually talk to anyone. We were optimistic about trying something new & were sorely disappointed.

title: Very compact and modern hotel
body: Very modern and great and convenient location. Rooms were small but very efficiently designed to make good use of all space. Brunch on Sunday was delicious! Coffee and other beverages available on each floor.

title: Very chic, clean and perfect location
body:
My wife and I stayed here for a week at the end of August. Booked on line through Expedia and got a great rate for a hotel in this area. The hotel has automated check in kiosks similar to those in airports. That worked very slick and we were through it and on our way in a couple of minutes. There are staff in the lobby and they will assist you with any issues, baggage, etc. Elevators take you to the 4th floor which is their "Mission Control" There are folks at the desk there to aid you and they are very helpful.
From the 4th floor you take elevators to the cabins which are very similar to cruise ship cabins. Really, they are completely adequate and very trendy. We liked the neat features like the powered, convertible bed, heated towel rack and ultra modern designs. When in NYC you don't spend much time in the room so this place is great for couples who don't need much space. Each floor has a "galley" on it where you can get tea/coffee/water/ice 24/7. There is a fridge and microwave and this room is a great touch. 
The morning breakfast area on the 4th floor was perfect. They had your typical muffins daily and pastries on a couple of days. Was very convenient to hit this for a quick bite and beverage before hitting the streets. We never ate at the restaurant but spoke to folks who were pleased with their experience. 
This hotel is ideally located in Manhattan for those that want to hit the streets, broadway and all that NYC offers. We went to two Broadway plays and they were quick 5 minute walks. The area is very safe and we could come and go at any time without issues on the surrounding streets. There is a large drugstore right across 10th ave and a short walk east on 42nd street takes you to numerous restaurants and a nice market where you could get anything day or night. It's only a five minute walk east to Times Square and the action packed core of Manhattan. There is great access to the subway, port authority bus terminal and the hop on/hop off bus tours so everything is in short walking distance. 
We will definately be going back to NYC again and we'll be staying at Yotel again. I'll be recomending this hotel to my friends. This was our second trip to NYC and we last stayed at the Hilton on the Ave of Americas. That was a great property but more than twice the $'s. It was over $300., compared to $145. which makes a big difference over 7 nights. Try Yotel if you can be comfortable in the smaller room setting, you won't be disappointed!!!!

title: Yotel New york
body: We had a very good experience in the Yotel. We were there for a stay of 6 nights. The Room was clean and the hotel staff efficient . We stayed in the family room which was a good size and very comfortable.

title: Love Yotel.....quirky, cool and different
body:
i just stayed at Yotel for the second time this year, the first time was on Business, so i stayed in a basic cabin....it was great they're compact but perfectly formed and completely teched up, plenty of sockets for charging, great TV's lots of nik nak space built in, great contemporary shower/wet area with incredible views over NY...perfect for 1 or 2 people on a whirlwind trip with lesser luggage as there isn't oodles of space for cases ( just 1 really ).
However on the second visit which i've just returned from i stayed in a VIP suite on the 26th floor and it was Incredible they are very trendily kitted out, large living area, spare sofa/bedroom with ensuite, large bedroom with moving circular bed that looks out over the hudson and the empire state building, quite an incredible view to wake up to ( though austin powers does spring to mind with the bed) :) there was a pool table in there, small side kitchen, coffee machine and large tv's, fire and 3 zeppelin Airs dotted around to stream music and there is apple TV fitted...it really is something pretty special, and i was even able to have 5 friends up to join me for dinner one evening, all 7 adults and 1 child could sit comfortably with so much space, and there are full length windows all around, so it doesn't matter where you are in the suite, there was always a spectacular view to look at.
The breakfast there if you do A la Carte is fantastic...my boyfriend is quite a food snob and even he said it is one of the best breakfasts he's ever had, also Dohyo do some of the finest, tastiest cuisine around, if you like sushi and chinese especially you HAVE to eat here it awakens the taste buds....it is still some of the tastiest food i have eaten.
The gym is great for short stays, though there are bike and run trails next to the hudson just a couple of blocks away.
There is also a really vibrant night scene there on a couple nights during the week, if i was one for having a good night out i would wonder downstairs to the club, but i'm more a chilled out in my room type person and surprisingly it is very insulated so the noise doesn't carry to the rooms.
the terrace is one of the largest outdoor terraces in NY and again its very trendy and a great hang out......
What else can i say i love this place, it epitomises, modern, fun, vibrant, quirky ...all in one.
only downside is where its situated could do with being maybe a few blocks east, but besides that the little walks to things are worth it.
enjoy if you stay there.

title: CLEAN!!! Will stay again.
body: Stayed one night with my husband. A perfect experience. I love to travel but easily grossed out by hotels. Very clean for those of you like me that get hung up on that. Yotel seems like a more modern, smarter, efficient, less wasteful way to approach the hotel business. Got a better deal going directly to their website than by phone. Other reviewers commented about the beds. We are in our 40's and they were very comfortable. Might not be for a much older person. Also, the windows truly block out noise if that is an issue. My only observation about the window is that with a young child it might be a problem because they open close to the floor... Hotel also has a great vibe and while affordable there was not even a hint of "cheapness". Will definitely stay again.

title: Good hotel, a little different, but fun
body: Room was clean, comfortable and had all of the necessary amenities. I had a corner room that was very bright with a nice city view. Location could be better as it is a little too far west, but not terrible as it is in midtown. Some sketchy blocks between the hotel and Times Square, I would not walk that route after 9 or 10pm. Service was very good.

title: Compact, modern, and clean hotel
body:
My husband and I stayed for 3 nights and had a very good experience in Yotel. 
- The hotel has automated check in kiosks like you see in the airport on 1st floor and YOBOT stores your luggage and then you go up and check in on 3rd floor(don't remember it was on 3rd or 4th) to get your key. 
- The room was very small (you are in New York) but efficient and clean. You don't get to have coffee maker in the room but the coffee and tea gallery is on each floor.
- This place is suitable for young couples without kids.
- The mattress is hard and thin so if you don't think you will be able to deal with it then this hotel is not for you.
- The food and drinks at the restaurant / bar is not that good and pricey.
- The area is not the best but central.
- If you are traveling with friends and family and sharing the room, them you need to be ready for 'no privacy' because all you will have is a thin see through glass door.

title: the future's bright, the future's Yotel
body:
My wife and I stayed at the Yotel in New York for 2 nights in September 2012, stopping over before heading to Hawaii. I really cannot stress enough how impressed I was with every aspect of this hotel. It is nicely located on the west side of midtown, only a 5 minute walk to the times square area. First impressions count and my first impression of this place was very positive. The lobby was funky, modern, spotlessly clean and smelled amazing :) The check in staff were super nice although were hardly needed them such was the ease of the self check in process.
From the lobby you ride the elevator to the 4th floor (mission control) where you have a consierge desk, eating area, beautliful outdoor terrace and access to PC's. This is also where you find a second set of elevators which take you to the floor your room is located on.
The rooms were a mirror of the lobby: clean, funky, futuristic, modern and for the space, very well designed. The bed which folded away to a sofa at the touch of a button was super comfortable. The bathroom area was spacious and the shower was excellent.
The Sunday Brunch here which is held outdoors on the terrace is popular, a bit of a scene and good value so maybe worth checking out although not so good if you are looking for some quiet time.
Having stayed in the city several times over the years, The Yotel is is easily the best hotel I have found in terms of value and comfort in this price bracket. It has made my life easier when planning future trips to the Big Apple because now it will be my goto selection in terms of hotel. I only hope that before long there will be one in every major city thus saving us all the hassle of finding suitable accomocation on a budget.

title: Fantastic!!
body:
Extremely smooth check in, straight up into our room less than 10 minutes after our arrival.
We had a premium view cabin, and the view was excellent. The room was small and compact but made use the space incredibly well. The bed was so comfortable. The monsoon shower is a liiiittle weak, but I may be used to a power shower at home.
The rooms were cleaned every day without fail to a high standard, even when we left the room at midday once. 
The only downside is that my partner and I now know each other a little TOO well.. there isn't any privacy when using the toilet! 
Staff were always keen and willing to help out. Gina was great prior to our arrival in sorting our upgrade so big thank you to her too.
I would highly recommend Yotel to anyone I know going to NYC!

title: Great Hotel,great concept!!
body: My son and I loved staying at the yotel. The check in was easy, no waiting in queues. Room was clean and no noise from hallway or street noise. Great veiws of the city. Breakfast on the terrace was enjoyable,muffins were sensational. 10 min walk to time square. Ground control staff very friendly helpful and when we returned for 2nd visit they remembered us and welcomed us back which made us feel at home. Would stay there again if ever back in new York.

title: A different type of hotel experience! Just needs a little tweaking.
body:
The Yotel hotel is a beautiful, modern, FUN place to stay. We had moments that we truly enjoyed being there but we also had moments of disappointment. Let's start with the negatives...Our cabin was not cleaned or straightened up on the 4th day, we stayed there for 7 nights. After that 4th day, I noticed a couple of small puddles of dirt on the floor, it could have been spilled hot chocolate and I noticed that it was never cleaned up for the rest of our stay...which then made me notice the bathroom floor getting dirtier with each progressive day so I guess doing a quick mopping of the floor is not done even when there is visible dirt...hmmm.... We also had some technical problems with the room. The faucet of the bathroom sink only poured out water that was warm to hot water, no cold water. We got used to brushing our teeth with warm water. The biggest problem was the thermostat. We stayed for 7 nights and for at least for 5 nights, we called someone up to the room to reset it. The thermostat kept resetting itself to 80 degrees! Too warm! The last tech that came up did say it might be a real problem. He did fix it temporarily, he even came by a couple of hours later to check if it was running okay but the next day when we returned to our room and the thermostat would not go down to 70 degrees. We couldn't even get it down to 72 degrees which the instructions on the panel stated was the default temperature for the thermostat. It was a real inconvenience having to call someone almost every night. Sometimes the thermostat would even go higher if we tried to lower the temperature. Really frustrating. We would end up opening the window, which added alot of noise to the room or kept open our front door but we had to close it, I didn't want to bother the other guests. The hallway was a more pleasant temperature than our room. :( What bothered me more was no one at the hotel offered to move us. It did seem busy so maybe there were no open rooms??
What was GREAT about the hotel? First, the check in. We arrived after midnight but the staff person welcomed us, helped us check in quickly and took our luggage up the room. He told us about the hotel, answered all of our questions, he was GREAT! The hotel is also beautiful in a modern, quirky sense. If you love Apply products, you'll love the way this hotel looks. So modern and clean yet there's elements of fun, like the strange but wonderful sculpture that greets you on the 4th floor or the huge, bright green couches in the lobby or the colorful, beaded curtains in the lobby or the other strange but wonderful sculpture that greets you at the Dohyo restaurant. Something we really loved about this hotel was the galley, I LOVE that place. What a great concept for a hotel. The galley is a shared room, located on each floor. The galley has an espresso machine, refrigerator, ice machine, sink, microwave and Coca Cola vending machine. We went there at least twice a day. The only frustrating thing, it didn't seem very well maintained. One day-no cream in the machine, another day-no coffee capsules, a different day-no cups but when everything was there, it was wonderful and the espresso was very good. The ice was easy to crunch. Sometimes the galley counter was abit dirty but I fault the other hotel guests. Can't blame the hotel for having slobs as their guests right? Spilled coffee! Cups full of coffee left in the dispenser and the counter! The hotel should probably clean up and replenish that area at least twice a day because it really does get well used. The hallway carpet was looking a bit soiled but despite this and our bathroom floor, I still felt the hotel seemed quite clean overall. Bed pillows were so soft and wonderful. I could see how some people didn't like the bed but I never had any problem with it. It is like a real futon, no cushing but great support. The dysfunctional thermostat in our room is what kept me up at nights. The towel rack was heated!!! The shower always had hot water available for soothing 'monsoon showers'. There were definitely some GREAT things about this hotel that you don't get at other hotels. If the negatives go away, the Yotel could be a FIRST CLASS, amazing, one of the best NYC hotel because there are moments of brilliance in the design of this hotel. I'm rooting for you, Yotel!!!

title: Yotel one of the best hotel in NewYork
body: A very good hotel which we really can recommend good location friendly staff. We will come here again! It is close to everything you can walk to most things Broodway, Meat Market, Central Park, etc. Good restaurants nearby

title: The place to stay in Manhattan
body:
If you are seeking friendly staff, superb views of the city, and excellent facilities with a slightly futuristic quality then look no further. 
One had a sense that the staff spent their time looking for opportunities to be helpful, and they really excelled at it. Dining was a delight, either over breakfast coffee and muffins, or Japanese fusion at dinner.
When we are next in New York we will not be thinking of any other hotel. Try them, you will not be disappointed.

title: Perfect
body: Perfect location, 5 minutes from Time Square and subway, Excellent view from cabin (19th floor). Extremely modern design. There was a galley each floor with free coffee, a refrigarator, ice and water and a microwave oven. The restaurant has great food at very reasonable price. Althought the room was little it was comfortable even for a 7-night stay. The changes the linens only twice but the towels every day.

title: Best start in New York
body:
I stayed in Yotel in New York recently for 12 days.
From even before I checked in the staff have been fantastic.
I booked a few months out on a 15% off deal. The week leading up to by trip I checked on the Yotel site again for pricing and found it to be slightly cheaper than my original booking, after a quick email to the reservations staff they amended by booking happily.
On checking at 9am on a Saturday I found the Lobby Staff to be friendly, welcoming and efficient. I was checked in within 3 minutes of my arrival and luckily my room was available! I was able to have a shower and change after 24 hours of flying! So I was able to start exploring in a fresh state.
Throughout my stay I made use of the onsite restaurant Dohyo and bar The Terrace. Both had fantastic service, Dohyo had some amazing food at very reasonable prices (I recommend you try the taco's on Taco Tuesday) and brilliant bar staff (happy hour every Mon-Fri 4-7 :) ) I also partook in the Saturday and Sunday Brunch which was a great way to meet fellow travellers and even locals :)
The room, while small, was really well laid out and had everything I wanted. I'm not a big user of in room bars/snacks, so the lack of these was perfect in my books, each floor has a galley with tea/coffee and soda's available as well as a fridge for your own food.
The beds themselves are futon style mattresses which may be a bit hard for some people, but I found very comfortable. The room I stayed in (25th Floor) was very quiet and when the window was closed I struggled to hear any street noise.
I would 100% recommend Yotel NYC to anyone traveling to the Big Apple

title: Good place in NYC
body: Rooms were little but not sound proof. Could here tv, music etc. from room next door. Staff were helpful and friendly except for one waiter at the outside bar who seemed he just didn't care about serving drinks. Good location - walkable to Time square, theatre's and subway. Would recommend this place more for a group of friends travelling (rather than a solo person) as the outdoor terrace is good place to relax with a few glasses of wine.

title: Spiffy hotel! Loved it!
body: We stayed at the Yotel in NYC for 3 days in September. The hotel was refreshingly different from the conventional decor you'd see in most places. The automated checkins and checkouts were very convenient and the Yobot (that stores your bags after checkout) was pretty cool! Location was awesome if you want to stay in Manhattan but expect small spaces. Their smallest rooms were about 170 sft with a decent view and is great for 1 person. Bed was very comfy and smartly designed to slide back when not in use to give you a little more room space. Interior decor of the rooms was really cool. If sharing the room with another, be advised that there is very little privacy with the bed and bath separated just by a curtain. Food appeared to be reasonably priced. The hotel staff were super friendly and helpful as well. All in all, I might stay there again, especially if traveling solo!

title: Very refreshing!!!
body: Yotel is a spacious and bright hotel with a lot of amiable features. Yobot is lovely, the staff is extremely helpful, rooms are gorgeous, very clean, comfortable beds and a clear sparkling shower, lovely fragrance throuhgout the buildung and pleasant music in the public rooms. The location is great and starting the day on Level 4/rooftop will provide you with just the view you wished for

title: Pleasantly surprised!
body:
I was pleasantly surprised about the Yotel.
It was very clean, new and above all close to the Javits Center.
Galley is very convenient and wifi is complementary.
Rooms are very small though but overall very nice experience.
I will come back.

title: Fantastic Place in NYC
body: Yotel, New York Times Square is an excellent hotel. The entire idea of marketing the room as cabin is an unique experience for me. The check in/check out process is extremely easy with the "airport" like check in kiosks, the staff are always there to assist you if you encounter any issues. The rooms or cabin as they are called by Yotel, surprised me. It is definitely larger than some of the NYC hotel that i had stayed in. Some people complain about the futon style bed. To me, that is not an issue at all. Overall, the room is very clean, cosy and offer a very unique experience for me. Location wise, i would say it is pretty decent, located about 3 blocks away from Time Square and Subways station, it is at most a 10-15 mins walk. Other than that, it is plain fun living at Yotel whether it is the check in process, the dining at their restaurants, the rooms, the lounge area or the extremely interesting YoBot. Highly recommended.

title: Yotel - Sep/12
body:
Very good hotel, second time there and probably not the last one.
Hotel is very new, clean and cool
Location is very good also, near times square 
Bathroom is very good, specially the soap (Get up and Get down)
Breakfast is good, with delicious muffins and cofee for free
I really love the hotel

title: The houseeeping was horrible.
body: They don't bother to straighten the sheets. The crewmember on '4' told me they could put a topper on the rediculously hard bed, but it wasn't there when I went back to the room that evening (but they did bring it when I called). When I asked for extra washcloths in the room I was given NO washcloths. There isn't even a shelf in the shower to put your things on. You have to set your stuff on the floor. There is no fan in the bathroom, so you're sharing EVERYTHING with anyone else in the room. They didn't clean out my shower. I will never stay there again.

title: Spur of the moment at Yotel NYC
body: Had to stay in NYC unexpectedly for business. Got a reservation right away. Love the concept. Love the friendly, attentive hotel staff, and Yobot is cool. The cabin though small was big enough and arranged conveniently enough with handy storage. Just enough room to do my stretches with the bed/couch fully back in the couch position. Coffee and muffins in the morning were a welcome treat. Mocha's from the galley machine hit the spot. The HVAC system is a bit noisy due to the small cabin size, and the vent which is fairly close to the bed/couch blows directly on the occupant--since there is nowhere else to be except for the washroom area. Dinner at the restaurant was tasty. Portions are more like appetizer size so order several and share. Fantastic carrot cake. The only miss was the restaurant service that seemed inexperienced to handle a crowd. I'll be back next time I need to be near the Javits Center. In fact I've booked the Yotel in Heathrow for a layover.

title: Great concept!
body:
Loved this hotel! I stayed here on a recommendation from a friend as was not disappointed. 
The room (or cabin as they refer to it) was a premium view cabin which meant we were on the top floor and had a a great view towards the downtown area. The cabin was small, but was absolutely adequate for a 3 days stay, lets face it you aren't in New York to spend a lot of time in your room! The bed folds up into a sort-of couch at the press of a button. It's not a proper couch, you wouldn't be able to lean back and have your feet on the floor unless you have abnormally long legs. But it clears enough space to let you walk around a bit more easily. I found the bed to be perfectly comfortable. 
I stayed on my own in the room, the bathroom is only separated by a curtain and a sliding glass door, so not soundproof by any means, and I can understand why some people may find this uncomfortable if sharing. 
The roof terrace on "Four" was great - free coffee and muffins to start the day and a lovely place to chill with a drink at the end of the evening. My only complaint would be that the bar was very expensive - it cost $20 for a beer and a glass of wine which is massively over priced for a hotel that advertises itself as a value for money location.

title: Design hotel for reasonable price
body:
As we were traveling with friends we needed to find a hotel that met all our needs. We wanted a hotel in Manhattan, near Times Square, preferably a design hotel and for a reasonable price (as far as prices are reasonable in Manhattan). When we found the Yotel everyone agreed this would be the best hotel for us.
The hotel met our expectations. The rooms (or cabins) are small but practical, the beds are awesome, the shower is perfect. Overall a nice clean room where you most probably wont spend to much time as there is enough to see in Manhattan.
