I have stayed at Yotel twice for business and I will stay again on my next trip. I might even bring the family up for a fun weekend in NYC.

title: Interesting Place
body: Stayed one night for business as I was working the ISC East Convention at the Javits Center. The Yotel was within easy walking distance from the Javits, when you check in you do it on the main floor at a kiosk and then up the command center on 4, then catch another set of elevators to your cabin, thats right I said cabin. The Yotel is an overseas concept that is featured in airports for people to freshen up in between flights. The room is small, the bed is controlled by a and up and down botton, basically it is a futon and it sleeps like one also, very hard bed, very little mattress. The room was clean and small, not bad for a single traveler, but not good if sharing the room or even with a partner, I would choose a different place. The staff was great and the hotel itself is very modern and also very clean and hip. The area is in the middle of everything which is great for going to time square and sight-seeing. While it is a very nice place, I am just use to bigger rooms and better beds so therefore if I could help it I would not stay here again, but thats just my opinion.

title: Awesome place
body: Went to NY for a conference and had stayed at old and expensive hotels before. I had an awesome experience at Yotel. It's a great modern hotel and the value was good too. It was very comparable to the older hotels around times square. Highly recommend this hotel and I will most definitely stay at Yotel in the future!

title: Great Location - Great Staff!
body:
Stayed for a long weekend, location really was great just a 15 min walk from Times Square, Paid for a Premium view room which really gave a great view out across the city, though rooms were a little on the small side, so I would suggest trying to get an upgrade if possible. 
Complimentary coffee's and Chocolate at the Galley were a lifesaver, however given the price of the rooms, a proper breakfast included would have been better than just a muffin and tea / coffee.
Overall though, would still probably stay again!

title: Awesome experience
body: I stayed at the NYC YOTEL for 3 days 2 nights with my two daughters. We stayed in the Queen size room, 1 queen bed with bunk above. This was by far the best hotel I have stayed in, everything is very clean, staff is friendly and helful, the atmosphere was fantastic, and after searching for a good deal, the price for our stay was no more expensive then some of the not so well rated places. Location is also excellent, within walking distance of all the major attractions. I would stay here again!

title: I would stay here again.
body:
We were on the 24th floor, in a "premium view" room, with a stunning view of the Hudson river a couple of picturesque blocks away. Room quiet and interestingly comapact. (I requested away from the lifts, on booking) Took ferry across the Hudson, to Hoboken, for sea breezes, views back to Manhatten, and a quiet change of scene.
I am not sure if i want to eat a muffin for breakfast ever again, but there was a handy deli type shop a block and a half back along 42nd street, towards Time square, where fruit was available, and lots of other stuff, some of which could be prepared in the small shared kitchen on each floor, with microwave and free coffee/tea/water. 
Also near to the shop was a "99c" a slice pizza place, excellent when jet lagged stomachs can't cope with anything more challenging. 
The rest of new york also good fun, as always. Enormous christmas tree outside the Rockefeller building, and ice skating rink, and lots of people shopping.

title: Great value for the location
body: Yotel is a unique stay and certainly worth the rates. It is very close to Times Square. Cabins are a bit small but that is to be expected given the location. Staff could be a bit more guest focused but overall a good experience.

title: Perfect hotel! Loved it here.
body: I stayed at the Yotel for 4 nights and loved every minute of it! I stayed in a corner king room.. The view was mind blowing! I couldn't stop looking out the window! Panoramic views of times square and the Hudson river...amazing! The location was perfect, just a few minutes from TImes Square. The room was a good size, really quiet as the windows seemed sound proof and had remote control black out blinds. The bed was really comfy, not hard at all. There was even two types of body wash in the shower. The bar was really cool, loved it there and the happy hour small plates were delicious! The complimentary breakfast was nice, and they even served proper English breakfast tea. Yotel is AMAZING! Highly recommended, can't wait to go back.

title: Yotel - NYC
body: Nice location, small but nice rooms and great service. Checkin process was smooth and completely automated. Rooms are small/compact but for business travel, its just fine. I had breakfast in the hotel, the a la carte breakfast was quick and the price was reasonable

title: Great for business travellers
body: When you're travelling on business, your hotel becomes your storage facility and your sleeping pod. You need things at the hotel to be simple because you spend a lot of time outside the hotel doing complex things. Everything at Yotel was streamlined and consistent. No surprises. No frills. Great perks where it counts. Everyone going out of their way to make things easier for you. Invaluable traits when you're short on time.

title: Excellent!
body:
I stayed at the Yotel while in NYC on business - while a little concerned that it looked like a yo sushi it in fact turned out to be a great experience, and an awesome place to stay.
Checking into the hotel was easy using the automated machinery, staff were on hand to assist you if needed. The rooms themselves were small - but this was expected. The beds were comfortable and automatic, so you can change them into more of a sofa than a bed. I am not old and do not suffer from a bad back, so messing with the bed was new to me, and good fun!!!
The 1st floor (check in area) also has the bar and food - at night this place becomes a mini bar/club and is convenient as I only had to fall into the lift to my room!

title: Yotel superb
body:
I have travelled around the world and stayed at lots of different hotels. Yotel was definatley different it's funky, clean has everything to offer all ages. The location in New York is superb the price is spot on and it has fantastic coffee free!! 
Both my husband and myself could not believe how friendly the staff are and how they do everything they possibly can to help. We loved our stay there and would use again without any doubt. 
The Yobot is soooooo cool.

title: Funky, interesting, fun
body: Yotel is a great concept with cabins that have everything you need very close to hand. The cabin has loads of power sockets to charge all the gadgets, great shower but was only very slightly let down by possibly the hardest bed mattress i have slept on. I love the little touches -- the automated check, the luggage robot, the 'crew' are great and the free muffins and coffee are a nice touch (the $9.99 breakfast special is very good). Plus the location is great just a couple of blocks from Time Square and close the water if you want a jogging route. Overall I would definitely recommend it. Would have got 5 star rating had it not been for the bed.

title: Loved our funky hotel!
body:
This was our first trip to New York and chose Yotel based on reviews and its location.
The hotel is so funky and cool, it reminded us of Citizen M Amsterdam....but better!
Yes the rooms are small but that's the concept.....the rooms are so well designed with lots of innovative storage space....and the wonderful, comfy, electric bed that folds to a sofa to make more room is a brilliant gadget!
Loved the galley! Yes, having a kettle and few tea bags in room is convenient but the galley kitchen had so much more choice....and a communal fridge....I did buy fresh milk to get a better cuppa! Be aware that the communal fridge is emptied on a Sunday regardless, this is to make sure food isn't left for days after guests have checked out.
The location is great, it was a little further from Times Square than I thought the address suggested but it was my first trip and didn't have any knowledge of the area.
It is about halfway between Times Square and the Hudson.....took about 5 mins to walk into Times Square or closer to 15 mins the day we arrived as we were hit by all the snow from the Nor'easter!
If the hustle and bustle gets a little too much for you, walk down to the Pier/Hudson, it's just a little more relaxing and open so you can catch your breath for a minute!
The bar and restaurant are great too. All low, colour-changing lighting and funky seats....seems to be one of the popular places for young & trendies (not us oldies!) to meet for a drink...we loved the cocktails!
If you need a recommendation for a local bar or steakhouse...try the West Side Steakhouse and Lansdowne Road bar...they are 2 minutes walk from the hotel (turn right out of the hotel and they are on the opposite side of the road).
All in all, we loved our New York base and would definitely stay at Yotel if visiting again.

title: Highly Recommend Yotel
body: My first trip to New York. Yotel was as it looked on the travel agent website. Clean. funky and spacious enough for our needs. Adequate storage, great shower and comfortable bed. Efficient services and excellent staff. I can't think of one negative, Will definitely return

title: Satisfied guest
body: It´s a practical hotel with a good location. It´s very modern and it invites the guests to a practical self-service. The price is high for the kind of hotel and for the offered services. I suggest to install a greater safety box because these are very small.

title: Great stay
body: Had a great stay at Yotel. Excellent hotel for a reasonable cost. Feels new, clean and welcoming. Cabins are surprisingly small but why spend that much time in the room anyway. A highly recommended hotel.

title: Cool concept, exciting, clean
body: Nice try for a hotel. Clean, friendly staff, neat ideas, good drinks. Nice atmosphere with good energy. However, beds are incredibly UNCOMFORTABLE! Great location, though. Just don't plan to sleep much. Had a good time, regardless. Would recommend for location and energy alone, but expect a bed that feels like a pull-out sofa

title: Very Cool Place to Stay - worth a try, i'd go back.
body: Recently booked a last minute trip to NY. Hotel prices were double what I wanted to pay. So i hit tripadvisor and found Yotel. What a very cool, hip, trendy NY hotel. From the moment you hit the ground floor lobby you know you've entered a not so typical place. They bellman has been replaced by a giant white wall with cubbies and robotic arm that lifts your luggage and places it in a cubby. Check in with a kiosk or go to the lobby on the 4th floor for some traditional check in. The lobby is very interesting - lighting and view outside are cool. There are two bars in the main lobby - one has at least a dozen glass room around the parameter with their own flat screen and couches. The other has sushi tables and a really cool vibe. Just outside the bar is a huge rooftop terrace - summer months would be awesome here. At night cool vibie music filled the bars and lobby area, in the morning the music was replaced with nature sounds like birds chirping etc. The rooms are very cool. They call them "pods" picture a really cool cruise chip cabin style room. My bed was a combination of couch and bed. press a button on the wall and it transformed into one or the other. The shower was a glass cube - three sides completely visible and a view outside. I ate sushi at the bar - excellent! Breakfast the next morning was standard but very good as well. Every floor has their own refreshment station.

title: Cool and clean
body:
Have recently stayed a week at the Yotel. Location is just perfect, just a few blocks from Times Square, but directed away from the most crowded streets. Room (or "cube", as Yotel call it), was very tiny, but big enough if you´re out and about most of the day. Bed was comfy, just a bit too hard (husband says it was perfect though). Bed´s back could regulate into kind of a sofa/bed by pushing a button. We could hear people if they were talking in the hallway, but nothing from between the rooms (not sure if we even had any neighbours during our stay..). So no problem sleeping during our stay, unlike what some other reviewers reports. Nice view from bathroom window (20th floor). Air conditioner/heating system was easy operable and quiet, a great thing after long, cold november days in New York. TV and wireless internet worked perfectly throughout the whole stay, and never any long wait for using computers in the reception area either. All staff I met was very friendly and helpful. Cleanliness also met my high standards ;)
Didn´t try breakfast at the Yotel, but complimentary coffee and muffins in the very comfy cafè seats was great!

title: I Love Yotel NY
body:
On a recent trip to NY, my first choice for a hotel had no availability for my dates. I stayed in the YOTEL in Heathrow airport in October (I've written a TA review on this)
and so checked out the one in New York. I'm glad I did because now I will only stay in this hotel every time I'm in NY. I love the vibes and synergy of this hotel - the staff are super helpful and friendly (Harrison at the Restaurant and Rene the bellman). This time I splurged in a room with a view and I was glad I did. My room/cabin was on the 25th floor (I had a view of the Empire State Building) and was just the perfect size for my needs and it had everything I needed. Even though I spent most waking hours exploring NY, I looked forward to my cabin at the end of the day/night. The hotel is perfectly located within walking distance of important sights and venues you want to go to in NY. Everything in the hotel was efficient, comfortable, convenient and clean! I need not describe its many cool amenities and services as they are aptly described in their website - I will only state here how much I have enjoyed the Yotel experience. Next Yotel in the near future is the one in Gatwick Airport.

title: Second visit in four months, just as good the second time
body: In NYC for a quick overnight. Stayed in a premium cabin on a high floor. Rooms are small, but modern and efficient and provide everything you need. WIFI connection worked well also. The towel warming rack and ability to plug your iphone into the TV are nice touches. Complimentary muffins and coffee for breakfast are always a good start to any day. Ease of check in/check out also were efficient. Two blocks to A, C, E subway lines, and three to the Port Authority. Will return again.

title: Heinz
body: The location is very central. You can reach Time Square in a view mintues walk. The rooms are clean an the service excellent. The rooms are a small, but at least they have enough space for a short visit.

title: Ultra Modern Hotel in a Good Location
body: Excellent Hotel. Easy Check in/out. Staff all perform well. Ultra trendy crowd @ the bar/restaurant at the weekend. Free muffins and coffee good for the early starts. Rooms where fun and functional. The higher the room the better, and with any hotel, ask to be away from the elevator shafts. I shall return to Yotel, and recommend it to all.

title: Well-designed, bright and comfortable
body: Yotel is very slick, don't let the neon purple put you off. The lobby is four floors up with separate hotels that require room keys to access. Always someone in the ground floor lobby to help with cabs, check-in etc. The galleys on each floor have filtered water and espresso machines that are included at no charge and are fabulous (there's tea and regular coffee too). Our room was small but super bright, very efficient and well designed. Great lighting, simple but modern decor, big mirrors that make the space seem larger but also a full-length and well-lighted bathroom vanity, large window with blind that still lets in ambient light so it doesn't feel like a cave, can be made very private even though it's so compact. The bed's mattress was a little hard, my only real complaint. But the fact that it turned into a sofa at the touch of a button was super slick and also made more room when not sleeping. Overall it was a great room. Not far at all from Restaurant Row, right next the the port authority which is convenient. Would definitely recommend and/or stay there again.

title: Modern style
body: You feel at a airport in the lobby because you need to check in yourself. You get the hotel cards for the room too there. But if there is a issue with the booking, there is customer service at the 4th floor. We had a room a little bigger than the standard and the view was fantastic.It fell like to enter in a air plane cabin again. Free Wifi everywhere without crazy access password. Muffins and coffee are free in the morning but it s possible to have for less than 10 dollars a good breakfast plate. The restaurant in the evening was more expensive. The wine was a little too expensive. Otherwise cool atmosphere with music everywhere. Often in the evening a part of the 4th floor become a nigh club. There was some big terrace and the summer must be great. 10 minutes walking from Time Square. 15 minutes walking from the High Line and 5 minutes from a major Bus station if you come from JFK and others airport. Some negtive points: the windows in the room, a little scary with kids under 2 years. Fun: the robot to store the luggage for free when checking is done. The check out is ultra fast too.

title: Cool looking place but not very good service
body: We held a business event there. We had 8 or so rooms plus the meeting rooms. Our event was a technology focused event so the hotel fit nicely into this. However, the meeting room event staff and hotel staff took forever to get any requests done. Sometimes we would have to ask 4-5 times to get something done that was needed. They may just not be set up well for doing business events? The room I stayed in was a bit beat up. We were placed right next to the galley room (place to get coffee and tea) and people started opening and closing that door at 7 a.m. until 9 a..m. with great frequency. I'd advise moving from a location like that should you get a room next to the galley. The staff that great you on the first floor were very friendly. most all the staff were friendly, but as i mentioned the service level was not very good. Food was pretty good. The beds were very hard and several of our staff had trouble sleeping on the hard beds.

title: Uncomfortable and Extremely Expensive
body: A folding futon with a motor is what these beds are, and the price per square inch for the room is more than any other hotel that I've ever stayed at anywhere in the world. There are MUCH MUCH better options in NY than this place.

title: ideal for a city break
body:
Just returned from a 4 day trip to NYC, location was perfect only a few blocks away from Time Square. The room was much smaller than I expected but in actual fact, it was perfect as we only wanted the room to sleep in! upgraded the room to a "room with a view" for $15 a night which is well worth it! they had a galley on each floor for free tea/coffee & muffins in th morning, but didnt get a muffin as people must have been up early cleaning them out!
Would definitely stay again on my next trip to NYC.

title: Not very impressed
body: No customer service upon arrival, check yourself in and good luck finding your way around, no one bothered to tell us there is a room on your floor where you can get coffee and ice ( no coffee maker in your room ) once you figure out the elevator system and make it to your cabin & beware that if you choose a queen with a premium view its just a little bigger than a closet but you have no closet so don't take much with you as you have to live out of your suitcase. The bed is much like a electirc futon couch that folds out to a bed and the mattress is like sleeping on the floor ! No amenities in the room except hand soap and body wash and that's it... Our premium view wasn't very premium (slight view of empire state building which looks pretty good at night but that's it ) The toilet was loose and so when we would sit down it sounded like it was going to fall over with you on it ! When we complained and was offered to move to the exact type of cabin but with no premium view which is what we went there for . Instead we got moved to a lower floor but was a bigger and nicer cabin this time with a closet at least and a terrace that had a hot tub but we couldn't use it , the small glimpse I had in the previous room of the empire state building was no longer that's for sure and because we got moved to a lower level the noise on the streets kept us awake at night and the best part is we got charged $75.00 a night extra for the inconvience which I think is ridiculous but we were told the mattress would be more comfortable because they started replacing them slowly so ask can you have a new one... Couldn't use the roof top lounges or bar because there was a booked event every night ! The hotel was pretty modern looking with the robot arm that stores your luggage but just step in to the lobby and take a look at how cool it is and then go up the street to stay somewhere else.... It was very expensive to stay here and then to be charged $75.00 a night more it really got expensive and just didn't seem fair to me ! Just saying... We won't stay here next time we come back ... good luck to you if you decide to try it !

title: Wow! What an awesome hotel and awesome customer service.
body: The customer service was amazing. The rooms were amazing and very high tech! The rooms are comfortable. The bed was slightly uncomfortable after a few nights but the customer service was to die for!! I loved the hotel and would highly recommend to my friends. The prices were moderate but I will return for sure.

title: Christmas in the city
body: My husband and I spent Saturday night in the city and had a great time. Yotel was a great location for us. We're good with walking but were pleasantly surprised by location. Port Authority is very close by - a couple of blocks so easy access to the subway. We actually try to stay away from mid town this time of year but for those seeking out that part of the city, it's just a couple of blocks away and easy to hail a cab for those non walkers. We really liked the self service check in and were thrilled our room was ready by noon. Small room, excellent design - very efficient use of space. For those looking for luxury, extra chairs and sofas, you won't find it here. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable and it was fine for two people moving around. It's NYC so you shouldn't be spending lots of time in your room but when you do, it's very pleasant. Would recommend and will definitely stay again.

title: Just come back from excellent stay in New York at Yotel
body:
We stayed at the hotel 12th - 17th December and had a premium view room on the 24th floor. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Yotel and all the staff were friendly. The room was actually a good size and every space was well utilized especially with the electronic extending bed. The shower was excellent and the only grumbles with the bathroom were the maid kept forgetting to leave a bath mat and the sink must be the slowest draining ever, but these are ridiculously minor.
The hotel is very trendy and very obviously brand new as the décor was very fresh and clean. The free water and coffee machines on every floor was a bonus as it was good coffee. We would definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family and is only 10 minutes from Times Square and in a very slightly quieter area although the hotel bar becomes a popular hangout for trendy locals on Friday and Saturday nights. Thank you for a lovely stay and we hope to be back soon.

title: Fun and efficient hotel concept
body: Was to spend one night in NYC before heading to Mexico. Decided to stay at the Yotel due to it's "proximity" to Times Square. Checkin process was easy with the automated machines. Room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The cabin concept is quite well done. Staff was very friendly, even though you would rarely need to ask for help as there were no issues whatsoever.

title: Great cool / modern hotel
body: read the reviews and yes the bed is hard. thought it would spoil our trip but it hasnt. I get a good nights sleep and they have offered to supply mattress topper / extra duvet but havnt taken them up on the offer (yet). Room / cabin very well thought out. very modern and clean. bed pretty cool with the electric motor sliding the bed up and down. room has trouser prees, hair dryer, desk, very nice shower with supplied shower gel ( Mary loves these as they smell good). you can buy their shower gel in reception for 15$. We paid for a city view and look over the river hudson. they are going to move us tomorrow to the other side of the hotel for no charge so we can get the best of both views. we had dinner in the hotel first night, wings amazing but stay away from the green thai curry. no tea / coffee in the room BUT each floor has its own galley kitchen with unlimited hot drinks / ice water. very clean and we definitely get our quota. Loaction is good. 10 minutes walk from Times Square and Subway. Plenty of restaurants nearby.

title: Excellent stay in New York
body: Brilliant value for money, with brilliant views from the 21st floor! Very good service and perfect for our first New York city break, would definatly book again. Perfect location to be in the heart ofNew York.
